summary_brief: 2026年4月3日，AI Agent生态迎来安全筑基与生态成熟双重加速：系统性安全加固从"点状修复"升级为跨多仓库的协同推进（gptme、Anthropic全SDK、LlamaIndex同日行动），Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0.0正式版发布标志头部框架进入生产就绪，同时gptme评测体系从21套件激增至90个测试，AI编程工具质量保障进入量化管理阶段。历史对比显示，安全议题在过去两周持续高频，今日则达到"系统性协同"的质变节点；评测基础设施扩张速度（4倍单日增长）则为历史首次，评估工程化趋势正在加速。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 系统安全加固进入系统性大规模推进阶段
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 跨多个仓库（gptme、TypeScript SDK、LlamaIndex）同步推进安全加固工作，涵盖 subprocess 超时保护、输入验证强化、路径遍历漏洞修复及 fail-fast 安全默认行为，标志着 AI Agent 系统正从功能优先转向安全优先的工程成熟阶段。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 框架生态正式进入生产成熟期
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0.0 发布标志着企业级 AI Agent 开发框架的生产就绪，同时 Claude Code 可执行文件支持、Fallback Models、Vertex AI 多区域支持等能力持续扩展生态边界，Agent 开发正从原型走向规模化部署。

engineering_signals.title: 评估测试基础设施持续深化与标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 评估套件扩展至 90 个测试，新增自动派生机制和交互式排行榜功能，评测体系从手动维护转向自动化管理，反映了 AI 代码生成领域对系统性能力评估的持续投入。

engineering_signals.title: GitHub Actions 工作流可靠性持续增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code Action 修复了 execFileSync 环境变量丢失和 subprocess isolation 问题，确保 GitHub Actions 工作流中的认证凭证传递和条件执行逻辑正确性，提升了 AI Coding 工具在 CI 环境中的可靠性。

engineering_signals.title: AI 框架性能优化与类型安全并重
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI 通过懒加载事件总线和 Pydantic 重构提升框架效率，gptme 修复 API 响应格式与 OpenAPI Schema 不匹配问题，体现了 AI 框架在功能完善后开始注重性能优化和类型安全等工程质量问题。

release_signals.title: Agent Framework 1.0.0正式发布
release_signals.why_it_matters: Microsoft Agent Framework Python和.NET同时发布1.0.0正式版，标志着企业级AI Agent开发框架进入生产就绪阶段，包含完整的消息构造API重构和Breaking Changes。

release_signals.title: Claude Code插件可执行文件支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 插件现在可以打包可执行文件到bin/目录并从Bash工具直接调用，扩展了Claude Code的Tool生态系统的边界。

release_signals.title: Agent Fallback模型支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Agno v2.5.14新增Fallback Models支持，Agent和Team现在可以在主模型失败时自动切换到备用模型，提升Agent系统的容错能力。

release_signals.title: Vertex AI US多区域端点支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic所有官方SDK（Python/Go/TypeScript）同步添加了Vertex US多区域端点支持，增强了在Google Cloud上的部署灵活性。

release_signals.title: 沙箱执行fail-fast默认启用
release_signals.why_it_matters: TypeScript SDK将沙箱依赖缺失时的默认行为改为立即失败（failIfUnavailable: true），而非静默降级，防止潜在的安全风险被掩盖。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw任务流持久化重构
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenClaw v2026.4.2重构了Task Flow系统，添加持久化状态跟踪和恢复机制，支持后台编排与插件创作的分离，大幅提升生产环境的可靠性。

release_signals.title: 大规模NLTK安全漏洞修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: LlamaIndex v0.14.20修复了广泛影响所有embedding模块的NLTK漏洞，涉及超过80个子包，同步修复了Azure OpenAI等多个集成包。

release_signals.title: xAI视频扩展和R2V支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Vercel AI SDK的xAI provider新增视频扩展和reference-to-video (R2V)支持，丰富了多模态内容生成能力。

release_signals.title: CrewAI性能优化与Pydantic重构
release_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI v1.13.0通过懒加载事件总线减少框架开销，并将Flow和LLM类转换为Pydantic BaseModel，提升类型安全性和序列化性能。

release_signals.title: Agent Browser Bedrock集成
release_signals.why_it_matters: Vercel Agent Browser新增AWS Bedrock AgentCore作为云浏览器provider，支持完整的AWS凭证链，扩展了浏览器自动化能力。

## What's changed

- Added MCP tool result persistence override via `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation (up to 500K), allowing larger results like DB schemas to pass through without truncation
- Added `disableSkillShellExecution` setting to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands
- Added support for multi-line prompts in `claude-cli://open?q=` deep links (encoded newlines `%0A` no longer rejected)
- Plugins can now ship executables under `bin/` and invoke them as bare commands from the Bash tool
- Fixed transcript chain breaks on `--resume` that could lose conversation history when async transcript writes fail silently
- Fixed `cmd+delete` not deleting to start of line on iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Windows Terminal
- Fixed plan mode in remote sessions losing track of the plan file after a container restart, which caused permission prompts on plan edits and an empty plan-approval modal
- Fixed JSON schema validation for `permissions.defaultMode: "auto"` in settings.json
- Fixed Windows version cleanup not protecting the active version's rollback copy
- `/feedback` now explains why it's unavailable instead of disappearing from the slash menu
- Improved `/claude-api` skill guidance for agent design patterns including tool surface decisions, context management, and caching strategy
- Improved performance: faster `stripAnsi` on Bun by routing through `Bun.stripANSI`
- Edit tool now uses shorter `old_string` anchors, reducing output tokens

key_changes: 新增 MCP tool result 持久化覆盖设置，通过 `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` 注解支持高达 500K 字符的结果
新增 `disableSkillShellExecution` 设置项，可禁用技能和插件中的内联 shell 执行
Plugins 现可打包可执行文件到 `bin/` 目录并通过 Bash 工具直接调用
修复 `--resume` 时异步转录写入失败导致的对话历史丢失问题
修复 plan mode 在远程会话容器重启后丢失 plan file 追踪的问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.1.91 版本带来了多项新功能和改进，包括 MCP tool 结果大小自定义、shell 执行权限控制、plugins 可执行文件支持等重要功能。同时修复了多个影响用户体验的 bug，包括 `--resume` 对话历史丢失、`cmd+delete` 快捷键在多个终端不工作、以及 plan mode 远程会话兼容性问题。性能方面也进行了优化，Edit tool 减少了输出 token 数量。

## What's changed

- Added optional `terminal_reason` field to result messages, exposing why the query loop terminated (`completed`, `aborted_tools`, `max_turns`, `blocking_limit`, etc.)
- Added `'auto'` to the public `PermissionMode` type
- Changed `sandbox` option to default `failIfUnavailable` to `true` when `enabled: true` is passed — `query()` will emit an error result and exit if sandbox dependencies are missing, instead of silently running unsandboxed. Set `failIfUnavailable: false` to allow graceful degradation.
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.91

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.91
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.91
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.91
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.91
```

key_changes: 新增 `terminal_reason` 可选字段，暴露查询循环终止原因（completed、aborted_tools、max_turns、blocking_limit 等）

# @mem0/openclaw-mem0 v1.0.3

**Patch release — security fix, regression revert, supply-chain hardening**

Compatibility: OpenClaw Gateway `>=2026.3.24-beta.2` | mem0ai `2.3.0`

---

## What's Changed

### Security

* **fix(openclaw): path traversal in skill-loader** — `readSkillFile` and `readDomainOverlay` constructed file paths from user-controllable config values (`config.domain`) via `path.join()` without verifying the result stayed within the skills directory. A crafted `domain` value containing `../` could read arbitrary files on the host filesystem. Added `safePath()` containment helper that resolves and validates all paths before any `fs.readFileSync` call. The exported `loadSkill` API is now self-defending against traversal inputs.

* **fix(openclaw): pin mem0ai to exact 2.3.0** — Changed `"mem0ai": "^2.3.0"` to `"mem0ai": "2.3.0"`. The semver caret range accepted any `2.x.y >= 2.3.0`, meaning a compromised minor or patch release would auto-install on `npm install`. Exact pinning eliminates this supply-chain vector.

### Bug Fixes

* **fix(openclaw): revert broken Post-Compaction regex rename** — PR #4678 renamed `Post-Compaction` to `After-Compaction` in two noise-filter regex patterns in `filtering.ts`, claiming this cleared a security scanner false positive. The upstream system emits messages with the literal string `"Post-Compaction Audit"`, so the renamed regex silently stopped matching real noise — leaking compaction audit messages into the memory extraction pipeline. Reverted to the correct `Post-Compaction` pattern.

* **fix(openclaw): revert cosmetic comment change in recall.ts** — Restored `// Over-fetch for ranking` comment (was changed to `// Request more candidates for ranking` to work around a scanner matching the substring `fetch` in a code comment).

### Tests

* Added 12 new tests in `skill-loader.test.ts`:
  - 8 unit tests for `safePath()` covering parent traversal, deep traversal, nested segment traversal, bare `..`, valid paths, and disguised traversal
  - 4 integration tests for `loadSkill()` covering traversal rejection, valid skill loading, and malicious domain overlay with valid skill

---

## Upgrade

```bash
openclaw plugins install @mem0/openclaw-mem0@1.0.3
```

No configuration changes required. Fully backward-compatible with v1.0.2.

---

key_changes: 安全修复：修复 path.join() 路径遍历漏洞，添加 safePath() 验证函数防止通过 ../ 读取任意文件
供应链安全：将 mem0ai 依赖从 ^2.3.0 精确锁定为 2.3.0，防止被污染版本自动安装
Bug 修复：还原被错误重命名的 Post-Compaction 正则表达式，修复审计消息泄露问题
Bug 修复：还原被误改的 Over-fetch for ranking 注释
新增 12 个安全测试用例覆盖 safePath() 函数的各类路径遍历场景
ai_summary.summary_cn: 这是一个安全性修复版本，修复了 skill-loader 中的路径遍历漏洞（可被利用读取任意文件）和依赖版本锁定问题（防止供应链攻击）。同时还原了两个因误改正则表达式导致的 bug：Post-Compaction 审计消息匹配失败和注释被错误修改。新增 12 个测试用例加强安全覆盖。

Patch release that eliminates the OpenClaw security scanner warning by removing redundant `process.env` access from the plugin bundle.

# @mem0/cli Changelog

## 0.1.2

### New Features

- **Event commands** — `mem0 event list` and `mem0 event status <id>` to track background processing events (#4649)
- **`--json` / `--agent` global flag** — switches all command output to a structured JSON envelope for programmatic and agent consumption (#4649)
- **Email verification login** — `mem0 init` now supports email-based verification code login in addition to API key (#4623)
- **Brand refresh** — updated color palette from purple to golden (#4664)

### Bug Fixes

- **Fix critical crash** on startup in certain environments (#4636)
- **Fix `status` command** — now uses lightweight `/v1/ping/` endpoint instead of heavyweight entity/memory checks (#4649)
- **Fix double error printing** — `cmd_add` was printing errors twice (once explicitly, once via `timed_status`) (#4636)
- **Fix entity delete** — switched from v1 to v2 API (`DELETE /v2/entities/{type}/{id}/`), all entity types now work (#4649)
- **Fix `mem0 init` in non-TTY** — `--api-key` alone now defaults `user_id` to `$USER`; warns before overwriting existing config with `--force` flag (#4649)
- **Fix stdin hang** — `add`, `search`, `update` no longer hang waiting for stdin when called with no input (#4649)
- **Deduplicate PENDING results** — shows "1 event pending" instead of misleading "2 memories extracted" in `mem0 add` (#4649)
- **Auth error UX** — all commands show a helpful `mem0 init` hint when unauthenticated (#4649)

### Improvements

- **Agent output sanitization** — raw API responses are projected to only relevant fields per command, removing noise like `graph_status` and duplicate scope fields (#4649)
- **Full UUIDs in tables** — no longer truncated, so `mem0 get <id>` works directly from table output (#4636)
- **Score column in search** — search results now show relevance scores (#4636)
- **Short config aliases** — `config get api_key`, `user_id`, etc. now work (#4636)
- **Client-side validation** — validates `--expires`, `--page-size`, `--page`, `--top-k`, `--threshold`, and empty content before hitting the API (#4636)
- **Better API error messages** — shows full response detail instead of bare "Bad Request" (#4636)
- **`mem0 version`** registered as a proper subcommand (#4636)
- **`list -o json`** returns a pagination envelope instead of a bare array (#4636)

- Plugins/web fetch: move Firecrawl `web_fetch` config from the legacy core `tools.web.fetch.firecrawl.*` path to the plugin-owned `plugins.entries.firecrawl.config.webFetch.*` path, route `web_fetch` fallback through the new fetch-provider boundary instead of a Firecrawl-only core branch, and migrate legacy config with `openclaw doctor --fix`. (#59465) Thanks @vincentkoc.

### Changes

- Tasks/Task Flow: restore the core Task Flow substrate with managed-vs-mirrored sync modes, durable flow state/revision tracking, and `openclaw flows` inspection/recovery primitives so background orchestration can persist and be operated separately from plugin authoring layers. (#58930) Thanks @mbelinky.
- Tasks/Task Flow: add managed child task spawning plus sticky cancel intent, so external orchestrators can stop scheduling immediately and let parent Task Flows settle to `cancelled` once active child tasks finish. (#59610) Thanks @mbelinky.
- Plugins/Task Flow: add a bound `api.runtime.taskFlow` seam so plugins and trusted authoring layers can create and drive managed Task Flows from host-resolved OpenClaw context without passing owner identifiers on each call. (#59622) Thanks @mbelinky.
- Android/assistant: add assistant-role entrypoints plus Google Assistant App Actions metadata so Android can launch OpenClaw from the assistant trigger and hand prompts into the chat composer. (#59596) Thanks @obviyus.
- Exec defaults: make gateway/node host exec default to YOLO mode by requesting `security=full` with `ask=off`, and align host approval-file fallbacks plus docs/doctor reporting with that no-prompt default.
- Providers/runtime: add provider-owned replay hook surfaces for transcript policy, replay cleanup, and reasoning-mode dispatch. (#59143) Thanks @jalehman.
- Plugins/hooks: add `before_agent_reply` so plugins can short-circuit the LLM with synthetic replies after inline actions. (#20067) Thanks @JoshuaLelon.
- Channels/session routing: move provider-specific session conversation grammar into plugin-owned session-key surfaces, preserving Telegram topic routing and Feishu scoped inheritance across bootstrap, model override, restart, and tool-policy paths.
- Feishu/comments: add a dedicated Drive comment-event flow with comment-thread context resolution, in-thread replies, and `feishu_drive` comment actions for document collaboration workflows. (#58497) Thanks @wittam-01.
- Matrix/plugin: emit spec-compliant `m.mentions` metadata across text sends, media captions, edits, poll fallback text, and action-driven edits so Matrix mentions notify reliably in clients like Element. (#59323) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Diffs: add plugin-owned `viewerBaseUrl` so viewer links can use a stable proxy/public origin without passing `baseUrl` on every tool call. (#59341) Related #59227. Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Agents/compaction: resolve `agents.defaults.compaction.model` consistently for manual `/compact` and other context-engine compaction paths, so engine-owned compaction uses the configured override model across runtime entrypoints. (#56710) Thanks @oliviareid-svg.
- Agents/compaction: add `agents.defaults.compaction.notifyUser` so the `🧹 Compacting context...` start notice is opt-in instead of always being shown. (#54251) Thanks @oguricap0327.
- WhatsApp/reactions: add `reactionLevel` guidance for agent reactions. Thanks @mcaxtr.
- Exec approvals/channels: auto-enable DM-first native chat approvals when supported channels can infer approvers from existing owner config, while keeping channel fanout explicit and clarifying forwarding versus native approval client config.

### Fixes

- Providers/transport policy: centralize request auth, proxy, TLS, and header shaping across shared HTTP, stream, and websocket paths, block insecure TLS/runtime transport overrides, and keep proxy-hop TLS separate from target mTLS settings. (#59682) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Providers/Copilot: classify native GitHub Copilot API hosts in the shared provider endpoint resolver and harden token-derived proxy endpoint parsing so Copilot base URL routing stays centralized and fails closed on malformed hints. (#59644) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Providers/streaming headers: centralize default and attribution header merging across OpenAI websocket, embedded-runner, and proxy stream paths so provider-specific headers stay consistent and caller overrides only win where intended. (#59542) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Providers/media HTTP: centralize base URL normalization, default auth/header injection, and explicit header override handling across shared OpenAI-compatible audio, Deepgram audio, Gemini media/image, and Moonshot video request paths. (#59469) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Providers/OpenAI-compatible routing: centralize native-vs-proxy request policy so hidden attribution and related OpenAI-family defaults only apply on verified native endpoints across stream, websocket, and shared audio HTTP paths. (#59433) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Providers/Anthropic routing: centralize native-vs-proxy endpoint classification for direct Anthropic `service_tier` handling so spoofed or proxied hosts do not inherit native Anthropic defaults. (#59608) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/exec loopback: restore legacy-role fallback for empty paired-device token maps and allow silent local role upgrades so local exec and node clients stop failing with pairing-required errors after `2026.3.31`. (#59092) Thanks @openperf.
- Agents/subagents: pin admin-only subagent gateway calls to `operator.admin` while keeping `agent` at least privilege, so `sessions_spawn` no longer dies on loopback scope-upgrade pairing with `close(1008) "pairing required"`. (#59555) Thanks @openperf.
- Exec approvals/config: strip invalid `security`, `ask`, and `askFallback` values from `~/.openclaw/exec-approvals.json` during normalization so malformed policy enums fall back cleanly to the documented defaults instead of corrupting runtime policy resolution. (#59112) Thanks @openperf.
- Exec approvals/doctor: report host policy sources from the real approvals file path and ignore malformed host override values when attributing effective policy conflicts. (#59367) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Exec/runtime: treat `tools.exec.host=auto` as routing-only, keep implicit no-config exec on sandbox when available or gateway otherwise, and reject per-call host overrides that would bypass the configured sandbox or host target. (#58897) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Slack/mrkdwn formatting: add built-in Slack mrkdwn guidance in inbound context so Slack replies stop falling back to generic Markdown patterns that render poorly in Slack. (#59100) Thanks @jadewon.
- WhatsApp/presence: send `unavailable` presence on connect in self-chat mode so personal-phone users stop losing all push notifications while the gateway is running. (#59410) Thanks @mcaxtr.
- WhatsApp/media: add HTML, XML, and CSS to the MIME map and fall back gracefully for unknown media types instead of dropping the attachment. (#51562) Thanks @bobbyt74.
- Matrix/onboarding: restore guided setup in `openclaw channels add` and `openclaw configure --section channels`, while keeping custom plugin wizards on the shared `setupWizard` seam. (#59462) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Matrix/streaming: keep live partial previews for the current assistant block while preserving completed block updates as separate messages when `channels.matrix.blockStreaming` is enabled. (#59384) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Feishu/comment threads: harden document comment-thread delivery so whole-document comments fall back to `add_comment`, delayed reply lookups retry more reliably, and user-visible replies avoid reasoning/planning spillover. (#59129) Thanks @wittam-01.
- MS Teams/streaming: strip already-streamed text from fallback block delivery when replies exceed the 4000-character streaming limit so long responses stop duplicating content. (#59297) Thanks @bradgroux.
- Slack/thread context: filter thread starter and history by the effective conversation allowlist without dropping valid open-room, DM, or group DM context. (#58380) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- Mattermost/probes: route status probes through the SSRF guard and honor `allowPrivateNetwork` so connectivity checks stay safe for self-hosted Mattermost deployments. (#58529) Thanks @mappel-nv.
- Zalo/webhook replay: scope replay dedupe key by chat and sender so reused message IDs across different chats or senders no longer collide, and harden metadata reads for partially missing payloads. (#58444)
- QQBot/structured payloads: restrict local file paths to QQ Bot-owned media storage, block traversal outside that root, reduce path leakage in logs, and keep inline image data URLs working. (#58453) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- Image generation/providers: route OpenAI, MiniMax, and fal image requests through the shared provider HTTP transport path so custom base URLs, guarded private-network routing, and provider request defaults stay aligned with the rest of provider HTTP. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Image generation/providers: stop inferring private-network access from configured OpenAI, MiniMax, and fal image base URLs, and cap shared HTTP error-body reads so hostile or misconfigured endpoints fail closed without relaxing SSRF policy or buffering unbounded error payloads. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Browser/host inspection: keep static Chrome inspection helpers out of the activated browser runtime so `openclaw doctor browser` and related checks do not eagerly load the bundled browser plugin. (#59471) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Browser/CDP: normalize trailing-dot localhost absolute-form hosts before loopback checks so remote CDP websocket URLs like `ws://localhost.:...` rewrite back to the configured remote host. (#59236) Thanks @mappel-nv.
- Agents/output sanitization: strip namespaced `antml:thinking` blocks from user-visible text so Anthropic-style internal monologue tags do not leak into replies. (#59550) Thanks @obviyus.
- Kimi Coding/tools: normalize Anthropic tool payloads into the OpenAI-compatible function shape Kimi Coding expects so tool calls stop losing required arguments. (#59440) Thanks @obviyus.
- Image tool/paths: resolve relative local media paths against the agent `workspaceDir` instead of `process.cwd()` so inputs like `inbox/receipt.png` pass the local-path allowlist reliably. (#57222) Thanks Priyansh Gupta.
- Podman/launch: remove noisy container output from `scripts/run-openclaw-podman.sh` and align the Podman install guidance with the quieter startup flow. (#59368) Thanks @sallyom.
- Plugins/runtime: keep LINE reply directives and browser-backed cleanup/reset flows working even when those plugins are disabled while tightening bundled plugin activation guards. (#59412) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- ACP/gateway reconnects: keep ACP prompts alive across transient websocket drops while still failing boundedly when reconnect recovery does not complete. (#59473) Thanks @obviyus.
- ACP/gateway reconnects: reject stale pre-ack ACP prompts after reconnect grace expiry so callers fail cleanly instead of hanging indefinitely when the gateway never confirms the run.
- Gateway/session kill: enforce HTTP operator scopes on session kill requests and gate authorization before session lookup so unauthenticated callers cannot probe session existence. (#59128) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- MS Teams/logging: format non-`Error` failures with the shared unknown-error helper so logs stop collapsing caught SDK or Axios objects into `[object Object]`. (#59321) Thanks @bradgroux.
- Channels/setup: ignore untrusted workspace channel plugins during setup resolution so a shadowing workspace plugin cannot override built-in channel setup/login flows unless explicitly trusted in config. (#59158) Thanks @mappel-nv.
- Exec/Windows: restore allowlist enforcement with quote-aware `argPattern` matching across gateway and node exec, and surface accurate dynamic pre-approved executable hints in the exec tool description. (#56285) Thanks @kpngr.
- Gateway: prune empty `node-pending-work` state entries after explicit acknowledgments and natural expiry so the per-node state map no longer grows indefinitely. (#58179) Thanks @gavyngong.
- Webhooks/secret comparison: replace ad-hoc timing-safe secret comparisons across BlueBubbles, Feishu, Mattermost, Telegram, Twilio, and Zalo webhook handlers with the shared `safeEqualSecret` helper and reject empty auth tokens in BlueBubbles. (#58432) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- OpenShell/mirror: constrain `remoteWorkspaceDir` and `remoteAgentWorkspaceDir` to the managed `/sandbox` and `/agent` roots, and keep mirror sync from overwriting or removing user-added shell roots during config synchronization. (#58515) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Plugins/activation: preserve explicit, auto-enabled, and default activation provenance plus reason metadata across CLI, gateway bootstrap, and status surfaces so plugin enablement state stays accurate after auto-enable resolution. (#59641) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Exec/env: block additional host environment override pivots for package roots, language runtimes, compiler include paths, and credential/config locations so request-scoped exec cannot redirect trusted toolchains or config lookups. (#59233) Thanks @drobison00.
- Dotenv/workspace overrides: block workspace `.env` files from overriding `OPENCLAW_PINNED_PYTHON` and `OPENCLAW_PINNED_WRITE_PYTHON` so trusted helper interpreters cannot be redirected by repo-local env injection. (#58473) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Plugins/install: accept JSON5 syntax in `openclaw.plugin.json` and bundle `plugin.json` manifests during install/validation, so third-party plugins with trailing commas, comments, or unquoted keys no longer fail to install. (#59084) Thanks @singleGanghood.
- Telegram/exec approvals: rewrite shared `/approve … allow-always` callback payloads to `/approve … always` before Telegram button rendering so plugin approval IDs still fit Telegram's `callback_data` limit and keep the Allow Always action visible. (#59217) Thanks @jameslcowan.
- Cron/exec timeouts: surface timed-out `exec` and `bash` failures in isolated cron runs even when `verbose: off`, including custom session-target cron jobs, so scheduled runs stop failing silently. (#58247) Thanks @skainguyen1412.
- Telegram/exec approvals: fall back to the origin session key for async approval followups and keep resume-failure status delivery sanitized so Telegram followups still land without leaking raw exec metadata. (#59351) Thanks @seonang.
- Node-host/exec approvals: bind `pnpm dlx` invocations through the approval planner's mutable-script path so the effective runtime command is resolved for approval instead of being left unbound. (#58374)
- Exec/node hosts: stop forwarding the gateway workspace cwd to remote node exec when no workdir was explicitly requested, so cross-platform node approvals fall back to the node default cwd instead of failing with `SYSTEM_RUN_DENIED`. (#58977) Thanks @Starhappysh.
- Exec approvals/channels: decouple initiating-surface approval availability from native delivery enablement so Telegram, Slack, and Discord still expose approvals when approvers exist and native target routing is configured separately. (#59776) Thanks @joelnishanth.

## 🚀 ClawX v0.3.5

ClawX - Graphical AI Assistant based on OpenClaw

### 📦 Downloads

Please select the appropriate installer for your operating system and architecture:

#### macOS
- **Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)**: `ClawX-*-mac-arm64.dmg`
- **Intel (x64)**: `ClawX-*-mac-x64.dmg`

#### Windows
- **Installer (x64)**: `ClawX-*-win-x64.exe`
- **Installer (ARM64)**: `ClawX-*-win-arm64.exe`

#### Linux
- **AppImage (x64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (Universal format, recommended)
- **AppImage (ARM64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-arm64.AppImage`
- **Debian/Ubuntu (x64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-amd64.deb`
- **Debian/Ubuntu (ARM64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-arm64.deb`
- **RPM (x64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-x86_64.rpm`

### 📝 Release Notes

See the auto-generated release notes below for detailed changes.

### ⚠️ Installation Notes

- **macOS**: On first launch, you may see "cannot verify developer". Go to System Preferences → Security & Privacy to allow the app to run
- **Windows**: SmartScreen may block the app. Click "More info" → "Run anyway" to proceed
- **Linux AppImage**: First run `chmod +x ClawX-*.AppImage` to add execute permission. On Ubuntu 22.04 you may also need `sudo apt install libfuse2`; on Ubuntu 24.04 use `sudo apt install libfuse2t64`
- **Linux .deb (Ubuntu 24.04)**: If installation fails due to missing dependencies, use `sudo apt install libgtk-3-0t64 libnotify4t64 libxss1t64` before installing

---

💬 Found an issue? Please submit an [Issue](https://github.com/ValueCell-ai/ClawX/issues)


## What's Changed
* [codex] Preserve stable snapshots and stabilize Electron e2e by @ashione in https://github.com/ValueCell-ai/ClawX/pull/734
* Upgrade openclaw to 4.1 by @su8su in https://github.com/ValueCell-ai/ClawX/pull/742

* v0.3.5 by @su8su in https://github.com/ValueCell-ai/ClawX/pull/748


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ValueCell-ai/ClawX/compare/v0.3.4...v0.3.5

## [1.0.0] - 2026-04-02

>[!IMPORTANT]
> For any breaking changes & updates, please view this [migration guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/agent-framework/support/upgrade/python-2026-significant-changes).

### Added

- **repo**: Add `PACKAGE_STATUS.md` to track lifecycle status of all Python packages ([#5062](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5062))

- **agent-framework**, **agent-framework-core**, **agent-framework-openai**, **agent-framework-foundry**: [BREAKING] Promote from `1.0.0rc6` to `1.0.0` (Production/Stable) ([#5062](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5062))
- **agent-framework-core**, **agent-framework-openai**, **agent-framework-foundry**: [BREAKING] Dependency floors now require released `>=1.0.0,<2` packages, breaking compatibility with older RC installs ([#5062](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5062))
- **agent-framework-a2a**, **agent-framework-ag-ui**, **agent-framework-anthropic**, **agent-framework-azure-ai-search**, **agent-framework-azure-cosmos**, **agent-framework-azurefunctions**, **agent-framework-bedrock**, **agent-framework-chatkit**, **agent-framework-claude**, **agent-framework-copilotstudio**, **agent-framework-declarative**, **agent-framework-devui**, **agent-framework-durabletask**, **agent-framework-foundry-local**, **agent-framework-github-copilot**, **agent-framework-lab**, **agent-framework-mem0**, **agent-framework-ollama**, **agent-framework-orchestrations**, **agent-framework-purview**, **agent-framework-redis**: Bump beta versions from `1.0.0b260330` to `1.0.0b260402` ([#5062](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5062))

### Removed

- **agent-framework-core**: [BREAKING] Remove deprecated `text` parameter from `Message` constructor ([#5062](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5062))

### Fixed

- **agent-framework-core**, **agent-framework-openai**, **agent-framework-foundry**, **agent-framework-azurefunctions**, **agent-framework-devui**, **agent-framework-orchestrations**, **agent-framework-azure-ai-search**: Migrate message construction from `Message(text=...)` to `Message(contents=[...])` throughout codebase ([#5062](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5062))

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本期检测到 5 大跨仓库共性问题，涵盖 52 个仓库。其中"计划阶段错误详情丢失"影响最广（P0），"Agent 会话中模型切换失败"和"API 认证失败阻断主流程"紧随其后，均为高优先级的全链路阻断性问题。
global_highlights: **计划阶段错误信息丢失**：影响 52 个仓库，错误 detail 字段为空导致 Vercel AI SDK v6 等迁移场景下无法诊断失败原因（P0）
**Agent 模型切换失败**：跨 12 个仓库，用户在 agent 运行时无法切换模型，导致会话状态管理缺陷
**API 认证失败阻断主流程**：跨 25 个仓库，401 Invalid bearer token 导致整个应用无法运行，Insights/Stream 协议均受影响
**插件安全扫描误报**：OpenClaw 2026.3.31 将合法 child_process/环境变量调用误判为危险代码，且强制安装标志无效，影响企业微信等集成插件（P0）
**Phoenix UI 版本升级后无法加载**：跨 42 仓库，用户在新版本启动后无法访问 localhost:6006，核心功能完全不可用（P0）

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Terminal tool timeouts can collapse into runtime restart/crash recovery errors
source_issues.evidence: Reproduced in production Cloud with `gh pr checks --watch --interval 20` (timeout=1200). Datadog logs confirm runtime pod restart during in-flight tool call. Root cause in openhands/runtime/base.py: AgentRuntimeTimeoutError not handled explicitly, falls into generic exception branch. Also linked to k8s liveness probe config in runtime-api.

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by GetCurrentDateBlock with message: GetCurrentDateBlock.run() missing 1 required keyword-only argument: 'execution_context'
source_issues.evidence: Block raises BlockUnknownError: 'GetCurrentDateBlock.run() missing 1 required keyword-only argument: execution_context', causing runtime crash in core block with block_id: b29c1b50-5d0e-4d9f-8f9d-1b0e6fcbf0b1

source_issues.title: Handle failed Replicate predictions with retries in all Replicate blocks
source_issues.evidence: Bug: 'Sometimes Replicate returns a prediction response with status: failed and output: null. In these cases there is no output, but the request itself succeeded and we should treat this as a retriable failure. Currently, any Replicate block that receives status: failed just yields an error and stops.' Acceptance criteria explicitly requires retry logic up to 3 times.

source_issues.title: Marketplace data should be downloaded with Agent
source_issues.evidence: Bug: 'When you download an agent from the marketplace, you get the old title which was set by the creator in their library, rather than the title it was published under. Additionally you don't get the images of the agent downloaded from the marketplace. The intended behaviour is that the agent appears in your library just as it is in the marketplace.'

source_issues.title: Resuming a session keeps plans/tracker/tasks bound to the startup session ID
source_issues.evidence: Storage.sessionId is captured readonly at construction time; Config.setSessionId() only updates config state, not already-constructed Storage. Plan/tracker/task dirs derive from Storage's captured ID, not the resumed session ID. User sees resumed chat but plan/tracker state drifts to startup session namespace.

source_issues.title: AsyncPostgresSaver enforces instance-level threading.Lock() during asynchronous execution
source_issues.evidence: Benchmark: baseline 38044 reqs at 88ms avg vs locked: 9786 reqs at 1923ms avg. Throughput drops 5x, latency increases 10x due to lock contention on async psycopg pool.

source_issues.title: openclaw plugin error with pgvector

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: Converting MCP Tools to Kernel Function Throws System.ArgumentException
source_issues.evidence: System.ArgumentException: A plugin name can contain only ASCII letters, digits, and underscores: 'create-pages' is not a valid name. MCP server uses dash-separated tool names (standard naming convention), blocking all MCP server integrations.

source_issues.title: BUG: Persisted main session row can become stale and diverge from transcript, wedging new input
source_issues.evidence: Persisted main-session registry entry becomes stale and diverges from transcript. Gateway appears online but new prompts are not accepted from Telegram and dashboard surfaces. Manual deletion of the stale entry is required; gateway restart alone does NOT resolve it. Users are blocked from sending messages on the primary conversation surface.

source_issues.title: Plan mode allows bash commands to execute

source_issues.title: bypassPermissions mode does not execute settings.json shell hooks
source_issues.evidence: Shell hook script confirmed never called (verified via logs and lack of HTTP calls). Same hook fires correctly when running claude --print --dangerously-skip-permissions directly, confirming SDK-level regression. Workaround requires switching from shell hooks to Python hook callbacks.

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: Explicit false sense of security: callers configure sandbox.network.allowedDomains and sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite expecting enforcement, but configuration is silently ignored. No programmatic detection available. allowUnsandboxedCommands: false is misleading because it only applies per-command when sandbox is active — if sandbox never initialized, the check is never reached.

source_issues.title: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is cleared between prepare and execute phases, causing authentication failure
source_issues.evidence: OAuth token provided in env section is cleared after preparation phase, causing authentication failure during base-action execution. 9 comments, confirmed bug with detailed reproduction steps.

source_issues.title: Microsoft 365 MCP OAuth fails: duplicated 'prompt' parameter
source_issues.evidence: Clear root cause: the authorization URL contains 'prompt=select_account&...&prompt=consent', Azure AD rejects with AADSTS9000411. Workaround of manual URL editing then fails with AADSTS900971 (callback timeout). MCP integration is completely unusable.

source_issues.title: feat: allow configuring provider for developer extension's message augmentation (hardcoded Ollama dependency)

source_issues.title: You don't have enough credits? seriously

signals.topic: Eval suites all score 0% — model responses not recorded in conversation log, blocking autoresearch
signals.summary: In server mode, all eval suites (practical/practical5/practical7/practical10) return 0% pass rate because model-generated tokens are never recorded in the conversation log. This completely blocks the daily autoresearch pipeline (15 iterations/day).
signals.review_reason: Primary workflow completely blocked: eval system fails for all suites, autoresearch (15 runs/day) cannot progress. Model generates tokens but they are never persisted to conversation log, resulting in 0% pass rate. This is a clear main-flow failure with quantifiable cost loss (wasted compute + blocked automation).

signals.topic: Server mode: AGENTS.md files re-injected on every CWD change, wasting tokens and degrading UX
signals.summary: When running gptme via the server (web UI), _loaded_agent_files_var (a ContextVar) is not propagated across HTTP request contexts, unlike get_default_model(). Each step (HTTP request) starts with a fresh empty set, causing AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files to be re-injected into the conversation every time the working directory changes. The deduplication mechanism is effectively broken in server mode.
aliases: ContextVar not propagated in server mode
token waste from repeated file injection
signals.review_reason: Server mode users experience token waste on every directory change and confusing repeated system messages. While only one issue reported, the root cause is a systematic gap in ContextVar propagation that affects all server-mode users. Impact is real but non-blocking (workflow continues, just inefficiently).

source_issues.title: fix: AGENTS.md files re-injected on every CWD change due to unpropagated ContextVar
source_issues.evidence: Wastes tokens on every `cd` command in server mode; confusing user experience seeing same instructions repeatedly; breaks the intended deduplication design; each HTTP request starts with _loaded_agent_files_var.get() == None

This conflicts with the managed cloud auth flow which returns instance-specific URLs. Users end up with a stale non-removable 'Cloud' entry and must manually edit/save before anything works.

signals.review_reason: Users experience a non-removable server entry with wrong URL, requiring manual workaround before functionality works. This is an experience degradation for cloud users but is scoped to a specific deployment path (managed cloud auth). Count=1 limits priority to P2.

signals.topic: Long-running terminal commands trigger runtime restart/crash, collapsing into generic 'restart occurred' error
signals.summary: Terminal tool timeouts are not handled explicitly — AgentRuntimeTimeoutError falls into generic exception handling, sets runtime status to ERROR, and surfaces a generic 'restart occurred' message instead of a timeout-specific error — making debugging impossible and potentially crashing active conversations
signals.review_reason: An in-flight long-running command (gh pr watch) caused the runtime pod to restart mid-operation, emitting a misleading 'restart occurred' error that obscures the real cause. Root cause traced to missing timeout error handling. count=1 but high impact: conversation crashes with misleading errors, and any long-running terminal command is a risk.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Terminal tool timeouts can collapse into runtime restart/crash recovery errors
source_issues.evidence: Reproduced in production Cloud with `gh pr checks --watch --interval 20` (timeout=1200). Datadog logs confirm runtime pod restart during in-flight tool call. Root cause in openhands/runtime/base.py: AgentRuntimeTimeoutError not handled explicitly, falls into generic exception branch. Also linked to k8s liveness probe config in runtime-api.

signals.topic: CoPilot stop button does not abort backend processing, wasting resources and leaving agents running

aliases: stop button fails to cancel backend execution
signals.review_reason: Stop button provides false affordance — users believe they have cancelled an operation but backend processing continues. This causes resource waste (compute/AI calls still billing) and leaves agents in running state with no way to interrupt. This is a clear UX deception and resource waste issue.

signals.topic: Replicate block predictions with failed status crash workflow instead of retrying
signals.summary: When the Replicate API returns a prediction with status='failed' and null output, all Replicate-based blocks yield an error and stop the workflow. There is no automatic retry mechanism, causing workflow failures on transient API errors that should be retried.
aliases: Replicate failed prediction status not retried
Replicate block fails on transient API errors
signals.review_reason: Replicate API transient failures cause complete workflow termination instead of automatic retry. This blocks multi-step agent workflows and wastes AI compute on runs that could succeed with a simple retry. The issue explicitly documents the broken behavior and the expected fix.

source_issues.title: Handle failed Replicate predictions with retries in all Replicate blocks
source_issues.evidence: Bug: 'Sometimes Replicate returns a prediction response with status: failed and output: null. In these cases there is no output, but the request itself succeeded and we should treat this as a retriable failure. Currently, any Replicate block that receives status: failed just yields an error and stops.' Acceptance criteria explicitly requires retry logic up to 3 times.

signals.topic: DashScope阿里云API与thinking模式不兼容导致400错误和InvalidParameter异常

signals.topic: 启用PlanNotebook后OpenAITokenCounter对无type属性的工具参数统计崩溃

aliases: PlanNotebook tool schema empty properties crash
signals.review_reason: PlanNotebook是用户工作流中的关键功能，token计数崩溃直接导致agent推理中断。_calculate_tokens_for_tools方法未对空parameters处理，属于健壮性缺陷，用户在实际使用中可复现。有完整traceback和代码证据，置信度高。

source_issues.evidence: 启用PlanNotebook后使用OpenAITokenCounter，在_agent_reasoning过程中调用count方法统计token时，_calculate_tokens_for_tools中访问properties[key]['type']但properties为空字典导致KeyError: 'type'，traceback显示在agentscope/token/_openai_token_counter.py第158行，附plan工具schema示例。

signals.topic: AgentOS file upload rejects common enterprise file formats (.msg, .xlsx, .xls) — returns 400 Unsupported file type
signals.summary: The AgentOS run endpoints reject uploading .msg (Outlook email), .xlsx (Excel), and .xls (Excel legacy) files, even though these same formats are already supported in the knowledge router. Users cannot upload common enterprise documents via the run API, which is a main-flow block.
aliases: missing MIME types for Office file uploads
signals.review_reason: Main-flow file upload returns 400 for common enterprise formats (.msg/.xlsx/.xls), directly blocking users from submitting common document types via the AgentOS run API. The inconsistency with the knowledge router (which already supports these formats) makes this even more confusing for users.

signals.topic: Shared HTTP/2 async client causes transient 400 errors when calling OpenAI API under concurrency
signals.summary: The global httpx.AsyncClient with http2=True in agno/utils/http.py is injected into all model providers including OpenAI. OpenAI's SDK intentionally defaults to HTTP/1.1. Under production concurrency, this causes intermittent HTTP 400 'could not parse JSON body' errors that are hard to reproduce locally but cause real failures.
aliases: OpenAI API transient 400 errors under concurrency
signals.review_reason: Production-only transient failure that causes intermittent API call failures. OpenAI SDK maintainers explicitly confirmed HTTP/1.1 is their safe default; injecting HTTP/2 globally overrides this. The bug is well-documented with upstream references and specific file/line locations. While single-issue, the impact is non-obvious and affects any async production deployment using OpenAI.

signals.topic: Agent streaming router catches Exception instead of BaseException — CancelledError causes abrupt SSE termination without error event
signals.summary: The agent streaming router in agno/os/routers/agents/router.py catches Exception but not BaseException, while the team streaming router correctly catches BaseException. Since asyncio.CancelledError is a BaseException subclass, it propagates unhandled in the agent router, terminating the SSE stream without a proper RunErrorEvent.
aliases: CancelledError unhandled in agent streaming router
SSE stream terminates silently on client disconnect
signals.review_reason: Client disconnects cause silent SSE stream termination with no error event sent to the client. This is a confirmed asymmetric behavior between the agent and team routers. The fix is a one-line change (Exception → BaseException) but the impact is that client-side streaming breaks without any error signal.

signals.topic: delegate_task_to_member tool call completion event delayed by 60s timeout in Team tasks mode
signals.summary: When using Team in tasks mode, the delegate_task_to_member tool call completion event is not streamed immediately after sub-agents finish. Instead, the stream stays open for exactly 60 seconds until a timeout forcibly triggers the completion event. Affects deployments behind Azure APIM.
signals.review_reason: Production deployment (Azure App Service + APIM) shows consistent 60s delay on delegate_task_to_member completion. Main flow works but orchestration is severely delayed. Low priority label applied by triager suggests it's not P0, but the behavior is clearly wrong.

signals.topic: SurrealDB knowledge base creation fails with syntax error: FLEXIBLE must be specified after TYPE
signals.summary: Creating a knowledge base with SurrealDB backend fails with 'Parse error: FLEXIBLE must be specified after TYPE' because Agno generates DEFINE TABLE knowledge FLEXIBLE TYPE object instead of DEFINE TABLE knowledge TYPE object FLEXIBLE. Affects Agno 2.5.13 + SurrealDB 1.0.8.
signals.review_reason: SurrealDB integration is a key feature and the knowledge base creation completely fails with the latest SurrealDB version. Connection succeeds but schema creation fails every time, making the integration completely unusable.

signals.topic: 共享 Session Web 视图：桌面视口下消息导航弹窗在鼠标移出时消失，无法跳转消息
signals.summary: 企业版共享 session 的桌面视口中，鼠标悬停左侧消息栏触发弹窗后，鼠标移向消息列表时弹窗消失，导致无法点击跳转任何消息。
aliases: web share view desktop viewport bug
signals.review_reason: 共享 session 导航功能失效，属于 web 端关键功能不可用，但 count=2 且均为单仓问题，降为 P2。

source_issues.title: Can't navigate between messages in a shared session on desktop viewport
source_issues.evidence: 共享 session 桌面视口，鼠标从左侧消息栏移动到消息列表时弹窗消失，无法点击任何消息。

source_issues.title: All session messages in enterprise share view display as "New Message"
