signals.topic: OpenRouter API 计费双倍/计费异常：用户实际消耗 vs 报告消耗不符
signals.summary: 用户报告使用 OpenRouter 时，opencode 报告的账单金额约为实际扣费的一半，即实际被扣费约 double。已由用户两次独立验证，排除账户共用可能。
signals.review_reason: 明显的计费异常，用户实际承担双倍成本，且已两次独立验证。非阻断但直接导致金钱损失，符合痛点定义中的'明显成本损失'，应 P0。

source_issues.title: opencode is double spending or half reporting openrouter credit spent
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告实际被 OpenRouter 扣费约 $4，但 opencode 端显示仅消耗 $2。用户两次独立复现，已排除账户共用可能，使用唯一模型和唯一 API key 验证。

signals.topic: Ollama 集成在特定模型（gemma4）下挂起无响应，主流程阻断
signals.summary: 用户使用 `ollama launch opencode --model gemma4` 时终端挂起，Agent 流程中途停止工作，导致整个任务无法完成。
signals.review_reason: 主流程运行时挂起阻断，Agent 无法完成构建任务，用户体验完全失败。符合'主流程失败/阻断'的痛点定义。

source_issues.title: ollama launch opencode --model gemma4
source_issues.evidence: 用户执行 `ollama launch opencode --model gemma4` 并请求构建 React 项目，任务中途停止工作，附带了 transcript 和截图证据。

signals.topic: Plugin 通过 config() hook 注册的 skills.paths 对 Skill.all() 不可见，插件技能完全失效
signals.summary: 插件在 config() 钩子中向 config.skills.paths 添加路径，但 Skill.all() 使用独立的 ScopedCache 作用域，插件的变更对其不可见，导致插件注册的技能完全无法被 Agent 发现和使用。
signals.review_reason: 核心功能阻断——插件技能完全不可用，Skill.all() 持续遗漏部分 skills。用户已量化验证（65 vs 51 skills），且与 #20026 同类根因，架构级问题。

source_issues.title: Plugin config() hook mutations to skills.paths invisible to skill discovery
source_issues.evidence: 用户实测：静态配置 opencode.json 加载 65 个 skills，插件 config() hook 注册后仅发现 51 个（缺失 14 个）。作者已确认根因——各服务的 ScopedCache 作用域隔离导致变更不可见。

signals.topic: Plan Mode 未阻止 bash 命令执行，安全沙箱形同虚设
signals.summary: Plan Mode 配置未显式拒绝 bash 命令，导致本应仅读的 plan 阶段仍可执行 bash 操作，违背了 plan mode 的安全设计意图。
signals.review_reason: Plan Mode 被设计为安全的只读规划阶段，但安全配置缺失导致 bash 命令可执行，构成明确的安全/权限漏洞。符合'主流程失败/阻断（安全机制）'痛点定义。

source_issues.title: Plan mode allows bash commands to execute
source_issues.evidence: issue 明确描述 Plan Mode 权限配置缺少 `bash: deny` 规则，导致 bash 命令可绕过安全限制在 plan 阶段执行。

signals.topic: Mid-stream SSE error events report HTTP status_code=200 instead of actual error code (e.g., overloaded_error reports 200 instead of 529)
signals.summary: When the API returns HTTP 200 but a mid-stream SSE error event occurs (overloaded_error, rate_limit_error), the SDK raises APIStatusError with status_code=200 instead of the appropriate 5xx/4xx code. Callers checking status_code for retry/fallback decisions receive the wrong value, causing fallback logic to never fire (e.g., pydantic-ai's FallbackModel checks status_code >= 500 to decide whether to try the next model).
signals.review_reason: 虽然 issue 已关闭（fix merged），但该问题有明确用户影响：SSE error 事件返回 status_code=200 导致 fallback 逻辑失效，属于关键流程失败。P2 因 issue 已关闭，count=1，且修复已 merge。

source_issues.title: Mid-stream SSE errors get `status_code=200` instead of the actual error code
source_issues.evidence: API raises APIStatusError with status_code=200 on SSE error events instead of the mapped error code (e.g., 529 for overloaded_error). Downstream caller pydantic-ai's FallbackModel checks status_code >= 500 to fire fallback, but receives 200 so fallback never fires.

signals.topic: File upload with PathLike object in tuple format fails due to unreachable code path in _transform_file
signals.summary: When passing a PathLike object (e.g., Path('foo.txt')) as the second element of a file tuple to client.beta.files.upload, the upload fails because in _transform_file, the first if block catches the tuple before the second if block that handles PathLike reading can execute, making the PathLike code path unreachable.
aliases: PathLike in file tuple upload fails
signals.review_reason: 明确的 SDK 回归 bug：PathLike 对象以 tuple 格式传入 upload 函数时因代码路径不可达而失败。count=1，属于低频但可复现的 SDK 功能阻断。P2 因 count=1，无强用户影响证据。

source_issues.title: [BUG] `client.beta.files.upload` `PathLike` error
source_issues.evidence: Passing file=("foo.txt", Path("foo.txt"), "text/plain") to upload fails. The _transform_file function's first if block catches tuple before the second if block that handles PathLike reading can execute.

signals.topic: Structured outputs (JSON schema) rejects moderately complex but valid schemas with 'compiled grammar is too large' error, blocking non-trivial use cases
signals.summary: When using structured outputs (output_config.format with json_schema), complex but valid JSON schemas — with nullable types, repeated sub-schemas, and 5-level nesting — trigger a 400 error 'compiled grammar is too large'. This blocks adoption of structured outputs for real-world moderately complex schemas (~50 properties, 5 levels deep). $defs/$ref usage does not reduce grammar size. Users must fall back to prompt-based JSON instructions, sacrificing guaranteed schema compliance.
aliases: grammar size limit blocks complex schemas
signals.review_reason: 核心功能（structured outputs）被 schema 复杂度限制完全阻断，用户被迫放弃结构化输出来使用提示词方案。虽然 count=1，但该功能是 API 核心能力，且 schema 并非不合理（只是 nullable 多、嵌套深），属于 API 能力不足导致的显著体验下降。P1 因影响核心功能且有明确用户阻断证据。

source_issues.title: Structured outputs: 'compiled grammar is too large' error needs better documentation and higher limits for complex schemas
source_issues.evidence: Schema with ~50 properties, ~48 nullable types, and 5 levels of nesting (representing mapper/reducer definitions — a common real-world pattern) triggers 400 'compiled grammar is too large'. Structured outputs feature blocked for moderately complex schemas. Users must fall back to unreliable prompt-based JSON instructions.

signals.topic: Streaming with adaptive thinking returns stop_reason=terminated for tool_use when tool input exceeds ~6-8KB, truncating tool calls before completion
signals.summary: When using streaming with adaptive thinking enabled and a tool_use in the same request, the API returns stop_reason=terminated when the tool input content parameter exceeds approximately 6-8KB of text (~180+ lines). The stream terminates mid-generation, the tool execute function never runs, and retries produce the same result. max_tokens is well above needed output. Without adaptive thinking the same content succeeds.
aliases: adaptive thinking tool input size limit
signals.review_reason: 自适应思考模式与 streaming + tool_use 组合时，API 在工具输入达到约 6-8KB 时 stream 被 terminated，导致工具调用被截断、工具函数从未执行，属于主流程阻断性 bug。用户需要手动拆分请求作为 workaround。P1 因明确主流程阻断，非边缘 case。

source_issues.title: Streaming tool_use with adaptive thinking: terminated stop_reason on long tool input content
source_issues.evidence: API stream terminates with stop_reason=terminated when tool input exceeds ~6-8KB (~180+ lines) in streaming+adaptive thinking mode. Tool execute function never runs. Retry produces same result. Workaround: split large tool input across multiple smaller tool calls.

signals.topic: ServerToolResult content blocks for server-side tools (code_execution, web_search) are never delivered when client tools interrupt the streaming turn
signals.summary: When the Messages API returns stop_reason=tool_use requesting a client tool while server-side tools (code_execution, web_search) are still running in the same turn, the ServerToolResult content blocks for those server tools are never delivered — neither during streaming, in the final message, nor in the subsequent API call. This leaves orphaned server_tool_use blocks with no matching result, causing frontend stuck spinners and incorrect error detection in monitoring systems.
signals.review_reason: 主流程严重阻断：server-side tool 的结果（ServerToolResult）完全丢失，frontend 显示 spinner 永远处于 running 状态，监控系统误报失败。生产负载测试明确验证了问题的存在（5 并发用户、多种 tool 组合均复现）。该问题是并发 tool 场景下的系统性 API 契约违反，属于高影响主流程阻断。P0 因明确主流程阻断 + 有生产环境测试数据支撑。

source_issues.title: ServerToolResult not delivered when client tools interrupt the stream (code_execution + client tool concurrency)
source_issues.evidence: Production load test with 5 concurrent users: in all test cases where both server tools (text_editor_code_execution, web_search) and client tools ran in the same turn, the server tool results were never delivered as content blocks — stream ends before they arrive, get_final_message() does not contain them, and subsequent API calls also lack them. Frontend spinners stuck 'running' permanently. Monitoring/load tests flag these as failures even though the operation succeeded.

signals.topic: Multipart upload strips directory paths from filenames, blocking skills.versions.create()
signals.summary: SDK multipart form handling defaults stripFilenames=true, which strips directory paths from uploaded filenames (e.g. 'my-skill/SKILL.md' becomes 'SKILL.md'). This causes skills.versions.create() to fail with 'SKILL.md file must be exactly in the top-level folder' API error. Users must delete and recreate the entire skill as a workaround instead of creating new versions.
signals.review_reason: 用户主流程被明确阻断：skills.versions.create() 彻底无法使用（返回 400 错误），且无干净的内置 workaround，需删除重建整个 skill。当前仅单条 issue，但用户影响明确且直接破坏 API 合同。

source_issues.title: SDK strips directory paths from filenames in multipart uploads, breaking skills.versions.create()
source_issues.evidence: API returns 400 invalid_request_error 'SKILL.md file must be exactly in the top-level folder.' Workaround is to delete the old skill and recreate it from scratch instead of using versions.create(). The root cause is stripFilenames=true default in multipartFormRequestOptions.

signals.topic: toolRunner does not propagate container.id across iterations, forcing broken workarounds that cause infinite tool-call loops
signals.summary: toolRunner with code_execution_20260120 and client-side betaTools fails across iterations: (1) container.id from previous iteration is not forwarded to next request, causing 'container_id is required' API error; (2) setMessagesParams workaround has two failure modes — passing an object causes 'must be a string' error, passing a string causes infinite duplicate tool-call loop. No working path exists for streaming toolRunner with client-side tools + code execution.
aliases: container.id not forwarded in toolRunner loop
setMessagesParams causes infinite tool call loop
signals.review_reason: 核心功能完全不可用：toolRunner 与 code_execution_20260120 + 客户端 betaTool 的组合场景没有任何可用路径。两个 bug 相互叠加，无任何 workaround，严重阻断需要代码执行和多轮迭代的 Agent 工作流。

source_issues.title: Bug: `toolRunner` does not propagate `container.id` across iterations, and `setMessagesParams` causes duplicate tool call loops
source_issues.evidence: Two compounding bugs: (1) container.id from previous iteration not forwarded, causing 'container_id is required when there are pending tool uses generated by code execution with tools'; (2) both setMessagesParams workarounds are broken — object param causes type error, string param causes infinite duplicate tool call loop with identical inputs. No working path for client-side betaTools + code_execution_20260120 in streaming toolRunner.

signals.topic: TextDecoder.decode() fails on Node.js 22, breaking SDK on AWS Lambda
signals.summary: On AWS Lambda with Node.js 22, SDK streaming calls fail with 'Failed to execute 'decode' on 'TextDecoder': parameter 1 is not of type 'ArrayBuffer'. Downgrading Lambda runtime to Node.js 20 is the only workaround.
signals.review_reason: 在 Node.js 22 环境下 SDK 流式调用崩溃，是明确的生产环境问题。但有明确 workaround（降级到 Node.js 20），且 issue 中未见大范围影响证据，仅限于 AWS Lambda 场景，判定为 P2。

source_issues.title: TextDecoder.decode() fails on Node.js 22
source_issues.evidence: SDK version 0.71.2 on AWS Lambda with Node.js 22 fails with 'Failed to execute 'decode' on 'TextDecoder': parameter 1 is not of type 'ArrayBuffer'. Workaround is to downgrade to Node.js 20. Confirmed in comments affecting streaming API calls.

signals.topic: PostToolUse hook crashes renderer with H.reduce is not a function
signals.summary: When a PostToolUse hook returns updatedMCPToolOutput, the Python hook executes correctly but the JavaScript renderer crashes with 'H.reduce is not a function', causing all tool results to fail in the UI.
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure: PostToolUse hook returns valid output but renderer crashes, causing all tool results to display as failed in the UI. Clear stack trace, reproduction steps, and logs provided. Also surfaces a docs-vs-runtime inconsistency in tool_response shape.

source_issues.title: PostToolUse hook updatedMCPToolOutput causes H.reduce is not a function in renderer despite correct hook output
source_issues.evidence: Python hook logs confirm correct execution; renderer crashes with 'H.reduce is not a function'. All three MCP tools reported as failed in UI. Additionally, tool_response structure is inconsistent between docs (dict with content key) and runtime (bare list), requiring defensive isinstance checks.

signals.topic: SDK hangs and deadlocks when string prompt generates ~50+ tool calls with hooks enabled
signals.summary: query() with string prompt and hooks deadlocks once the internal 100-message anyio buffer fills up (~50 tool calls). _read_messages blocks on a full channel and cannot read the 'result' message needed to end the session.
signals.review_reason: Main flow blockage: SDK session deadlocks after ~50 tool calls with hooks enabled, completely stalling the session. Tool denials follow as secondary effect. Root cause identified and concrete reproduction + workaround provided.

source_issues.title: [BUG]: SDK hangs when string prompt generates more than ~50 tool calls with hooks enabled
source_issues.evidence: Detailed root cause analysis provided: wait_for_result_and_end_input() is awaited before receive_messages() starts for string prompts, causing the anyio channel buffer to fill and block. Hooked tools denied after CLI timeout. Session stalls completely. Reproduction code and workaround (bump queue to 10000) provided.

signals.topic: Preset system prompt embeds per-user dynamic paths, breaking prompt cache sharing across users
signals.summary: The claude_code preset embeds per-user filesystem paths (# Environment section, auto memory path) into the system prompt, making it unique per user and preventing prompt cache hits across users of the same application.
aliases: prompt caching broken by per-user paths
preset prompt cache miss per user
signals.review_reason: Significant cost impact for multi-tenant deployments: per-user paths in preset system prompt cause 100% cache miss on segment 2 for every user, eliminating prompt caching benefits. Affects all enterprise users on GCP/AWS who rely on prompt caching for cost control. No workaround available to SDK consumers.

source_issues.title: Preset system prompt contains per-user dynamic content, breaking cross-user prompt caching
source_issues.evidence: Explicitly quantified cost impact: segment 2 of system prompt is a cache miss for every user. Server-side prompt-caching-scope beta unavailable on GCP Vertex AI and AWS Bedrock (enterprise providers). No client-side workaround available to SDK consumers.

signals.topic: StructuredOutput enters infinite loop, repeatedly outputting XML-like text instead of calling the tool
signals.summary: When using StructuredOutput, the model repeatedly outputs <StructuredOutput> XML-like text blocks instead of calling the StructuredOutput tool, looping until max budget is exhausted.
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure: StructuredOutput tool use is blocked as model enters an infinite loop emitting XML-like text instead of calling the tool. Explicit budget waste confirmed (loops until max budget). Clear reproduction pattern documented.

source_issues.title: StructuredOutput gets in a loop
source_issues.evidence: Model repeatedly emits '<StructuredOutput>' text blocks and responds to stop hook feedback with 'You MUST call the StructuredOutput tool to complete this request' but never calls the tool. Loops until max budget is exhausted — explicit budget waste described by reporter.

signals.topic: bypassPermissions mode silently skips settings.json shell hooks
signals.summary: When using permission_mode='bypassPermissions', shell hooks configured in ~/.claude/settings.json are never executed. The PreToolUse hook for AskUserQuestion (configured as a shell command) does not fire.
aliases: shell hooks not firing in bypassPermissions
signals.review_reason: Permission bypass regression: bypassPermissions mode silently suppresses all settings.json shell hooks, breaking expected behavior for users relying on shell-based PreToolUse hooks. Hooks are a critical integration point for permission and audit workflows.

source_issues.title: bypassPermissions mode does not execute settings.json shell hooks
source_issues.evidence: Shell hook script confirmed never called (verified via logs and lack of HTTP calls). Same hook fires correctly when running claude --print --dangerously-skip-permissions directly, confirming SDK-level regression. Workaround requires switching from shell hooks to Python hook callbacks.

signals.topic: PermissionMode type missing 'auto' value — blocks ACP integrations and auto-mode settings
signals.summary: The PermissionMode TypeScript type in @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk is missing the 'auto' value that the Claude Code CLI already supports at runtime. This blocks ACP integrations from passing 'auto' to setPermissionMode() without type casts, and causes runtime errors when users set defaultMode: 'auto' in settings.json.
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports (count=2) confirm the type is out of sync with the CLI runtime. ACP integrations are broken — they cannot use the 'auto' permission mode that Claude Code supports at runtime. Users with auto mode in settings.json get runtime errors. Type-safe code requires type casts to work around a documented and supported CLI feature.

source_issues.title: `PermissionMode` type missing `'auto'` value in v0.2.90
source_issues.evidence: Runtime array EXTERNAL_PERMISSION_MODES in bundled cli.js is missing 'auto'. ACP integrations cannot pass 'auto' to setPermissionMode() without type cast. Users setting 'auto' in settings.json get runtime errors from ACP.

source_issues.title: PermissionMode type is missing "auto" value
source_issues.evidence: Explicit impact: users who set 'auto' in ~/.claude/settings.json get runtime errors because ACP's PERMISSION_MODE_ALIASES is typed against PermissionMode and cannot safely include 'auto' without a cast.

signals.topic: CLI crashes with ReferenceError when Claude Code is spawned under Node.js (Bun global unguarded)
signals.summary: Claude Code CLI bundle contains unguarded Bun global references that cause intermittent ReferenceError crashes when the SDK spawns Claude Code under Node.js (its default behavior). No stderr output is produced, making the failure extremely difficult to diagnose — the only signal is generic 'Claude Code process exited with code 1'.
signals.review_reason: Confirmed user-blocking runtime crash: Claude Code CLI crashes intermittently with no stderr when Node.js (the SDK's default runtime) is used. The error is completely silent — only 'process exited with code 1' is surfaced, making diagnosis nearly impossible without --debug-file. Affects the primary query() workflow. Workaround of forcing 'bun' executable is non-obvious and changes expected behavior.

source_issues.title: Claude Code CLI crashes with ReferenceError: Bun is not defined when spawned under Node.js
source_issues.evidence: ReferenceError: Bun is not defined — crash produces no stderr output; only exit code 1. Root cause: CLI bundle has unguarded Bun.which() call alongside guarded typeof checks. The crash is intermittent because it only triggers when specific code paths are reached. Workaround requires forcing executable: 'bun', which is non-obvious.

signals.topic: Empty settingSources array causes --setting-sources '' to consume the next CLI flag, blocking all default SDK usage
signals.summary: When settingSources is not explicitly provided to query(), the SDK passes --setting-sources '' to the Claude Code CLI. The CLI parser then incorrectly consumes the next flag (e.g., --permission-mode) as the setting source value, causing an error. This blocks all default usage of the SDK — any query() call without explicit settingSources fails.
aliases: settingSources empty string CLI flag parsing bug
Default query() call fails due to empty settingSources
signals.review_reason: Complete blocking failure of the main query() API entry point for all default usage. Any user calling query() without explicitly setting settingSources gets an error. The workaround (explicitly setting settingSources: ['user']) is non-obvious and breaks the expected 'simplest possible call' pattern. This is a P0 despite count=1 because the review_reason documents direct primary-API blocking impact.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Empty settingSources array causes --setting-sources "" to consume next CLI flag
source_issues.evidence: Bug explicitly states: 'This blocks all default usage of the SDK — any query() call without explicit settingSources fails.' Reproduction is the simplest possible query() call with no options. Workaround requires explicitly setting settingSources: ['user']. Additional context from #262 confirms: the default query() call without settingSources triggers this bug.

signals.topic: Sandbox silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed (no error, no warning)
signals.summary: When sandbox.enabled: true is set but bwrap (bubblewrap) is not installed in the environment, the SDK silently falls back to completely unsandboxed execution. No error is thrown, no warning is surfaced in the result stream, and allowUnsandboxedCommands: false has no effect. All Bash commands run with full filesystem and network access, giving users a false sense of security.
aliases: Sandbox silently falls back to unsandboxed when bubblewrap missing
bwrap not installed silently bypasses sandbox security
signals.review_reason: Critical security misdirection: users who explicitly opt into sandboxing get zero enforcement without any error or warning. The allowUnsandboxedCommands: false config promise is completely broken in this failure mode. Unlike normal silent degradation (e.g., missing optional feature), this defeats the purpose of a security feature the user consciously enabled, creating a dangerous false sense of protection.

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: Explicit false sense of security: callers configure sandbox.network.allowedDomains and sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite expecting enforcement, but configuration is silently ignored. No programmatic detection available. allowUnsandboxedCommands: false is misleading because it only applies per-command when sandbox is active — if sandbox never initialized, the check is never reached.

signals.topic: query() hangs forever when CLI subprocess fails to start (ENOENT / missing env) — no timeout, no error
signals.summary: When the Claude Code CLI subprocess fails to start due to a nonexistent executable or wiped PATH in env, query() hangs forever. No error is thrown, the async generator never yields, and even stderr callbacks are never called. The only way to detect the failure is an external setTimeout wrapper.
aliases: subprocess start failure causes infinite hang
signals.review_reason: Complete workflow blocking: query() hangs forever on a class of common failures (wrong path, missing env). The caller has no way to detect the failure — no error, no timeout, no event. This is a P0 despite count=1 because the primary query() API becomes permanently unresponsive on executable/env misconfiguration, which is a common real-world scenario. The root cause is precisely identified.

source_issues.title: query() hangs forever when CLI subprocess fails to start (ENOENT / missing env)
source_issues.evidence: Root cause clearly documented: readline interface on child process stdout blocks forever when spawn() fails with ENOENT — stdout never produces data and never closes. process.on('error') sets exitError but it's only checked in waitForExit(), which is never reached. Reproduction is simple (nonexistent executable or env: {}).

signals.topic: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-main default branch, breaking workflows for all non-main branch repos
signals.summary: Config restore hardcodes 'main' branch name, causing failures for repos using 'master' or any other non-main default branch. Affects all non-main repos regardless of trigger event.
aliases: non-main default branch config restore failure
signals.review_reason: P0 despite count=2 because it completely blocks workflows for all repos whose default branch is not 'main' (e.g. 'master'), which is a common org convention. This is a fundamental breakage of the restoreConfigFromBase feature for an entire class of users.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-"main" default branch
source_issues.evidence: git fetch origin main fails with 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref main' on repos with master as default branch.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on issue_comment events when default branch is not main
source_issues.evidence: restoreConfigFromBase hardcodes 'main' branch name, breaking issue_comment trigger on non-main repos.

signals.topic: claude-code-base-action@main hardcodes missing version causing 404 on install for all @main users
signals.summary: claude-code-base-action@main hardcodes CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION="2.1.88" in action.yml, but that native build is missing, causing all 404 errors at install time. Users of @main tag are completely blocked.
signals.review_reason: P0 despite count=1 because it blocks all users of @main tag from installing at all. Every workflow using claude-code-base-action@main fails at install with 404, making the action entirely unusable for the @main tag user segment.

source_issues.title: claude-code-base-action@main: v2.1.88 native build download returns 404
source_issues.evidence: HTTP 404 on native build download for version 2.1.88 hardcoded in base-action@main. All users of @main tag are blocked.

signals.topic: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN cleared between prepare and execute phases, causing authentication failure
signals.summary: The OAuth token is cleared after the preparation phase, causing the base-action execution to fail with authentication error even though the token was properly provided.
aliases: token lost between prepare and execute
signals.review_reason: Long-standing open bug (provider:1p, area:installation, p1) that completely blocks authentication for OAuth-based users. The token is provided correctly but cleared before use, making the entire action unusable for OAuth auth users.

source_issues.title: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is cleared between prepare and execute phases, causing authentication failure
source_issues.evidence: OAuth token provided in env section is cleared after preparation phase, causing authentication failure during base-action execution. 9 comments, confirmed bug with detailed reproduction steps.

signals.topic: MCP_TIMEOUT env var not forwarded to CLI subprocess, causing npx-based MCP servers to always fail
signals.summary: MCP_TIMEOUT set via step env, GITHUB_ENV, or settings input is never forwarded to the Claude CLI subprocess, causing npx-based MCP servers to fail due to the default 30s timeout being insufficient.
aliases: MCP server initialization fails due to timeout
signals.review_reason: Key feature breakage: MCP servers configured with npx always fail because the action's entrypoint doesn't propagate MCP_TIMEOUT to the subprocess. The default 30s timeout is insufficient for npx to download and initialize packages. No workaround exists — the MCP feature is entirely unusable for npx-based servers.

source_issues.title: MCP_TIMEOUT not passed to Claude CLI subprocess — npx-based MCP servers always fail
source_issues.evidence: MCP servers configured with npx commands fail to start because MCP_TIMEOUT (set via all available methods) never reaches the CLI subprocess. No workaround available — MCP feature is completely broken for npx-based servers.

signals.topic: v2.1.89 regression: permission denials prevent reviews from completing, causing infinite loops
signals.summary: After auto-update to v2.1.89, permission denial loops block PR reviews from completing. Claude gets stuck outputting 'I'll analyze this' instead of posting review results.
signals.review_reason: Confirmed regression between v2.1.87 and v2.1.89 that completely blocks the PR review workflow. Claude enters infinite permission-denial loops and never posts review results, wasting compute and failing to deliver the core feature. 5 comments confirm ongoing impact.

source_issues.title: v2.1.89 regression: permission denials prevent reviews from completing
source_issues.evidence: Auto-update from v2.1.87 to v2.1.89 causes reviews to stop completing. Permission denial loops trap Claude, which outputs 'I'll analyze this' indefinitely without posting review results. Clear regression with version comparison evidence.

signals.topic: Hard-coded Haiku validation model causes API validation to fail before review starts (404 not_found_error)
signals.summary: The action hard-codes claude-3-5-haiku-20241022 for API validation, which can return 404 not_found_error when that model is not available to the account — even when the user's configured review model is valid. This blocks the entire review from starting, with no workaround available to users.
signals.review_reason: This is a main-flow-blocking failure: the action terminates before any security review begins, purely because the hard-coded validation model is unavailable. The user provided a fully valid configuration (claude-sonnet-4-20250514 is explicitly stated as available), yet the action fails with a 404 — no workaround exists. This meets the pain point threshold of '主流程失败/阻断' and '关键功能不可用'. Priority is P1 (not P0) because count=1 and the rules require count>=3 for P0 on single-repo issues; however, the user impact evidence is strong and explicit.

source_issues.title: Make API validation model configurable instead of hard-coding claude-3-5-haiku-20241022
source_issues.evidence: Workflow explicitly set claude-model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514 (valid and available), but action failed during validation with: API validation failed: Error code: 404 - {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'not_found_error', 'message': 'model: claude-3-5-haiku-20241022'}}. The review never started.

signals.topic: Max plan quota exhaustion — Max 20x plan burns through $200/mo allocation in ~1 hour
signals.summary: Paying Max 20x subscribers report quota exhausting 3-5x faster than expected since ~March 23 2026, making the product unusable for professional teams spending $400/month. Multiple workarounds fail.
aliases: extra usage required error on Max
Max plan quota burns too fast
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports (Windows + macOS) of Max plan quota exhausting 3-5x faster than baseline with identical usage patterns since late March 2026. Issue #43274 is backed by a paying $400/month customer explicitly threatening cancellation. This is a core product availability and billing issue: paying customers cannot complete their workday.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Max 20x plan ($200/mo) — quota exhausted in ~1h, making the product unusable for our team
source_issues.evidence: Team paying $400/month across 3 Max subscriptions; Max 20x quota now lasts 60-90 min vs prior ~5 hours; tried autocompact fix, model switching, avoiding peak hours — all fail. Explicitly evaluating cancellation.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Max Plan User Getting 'Extra usage is required for long context requests' Error
source_issues.evidence: Max plan user hitting repeated 429 Rate Limit errors when context usage increases; blocks long-context workflows.

signals.topic: Cowork workspace broken on Windows — Plan9 share mount fails with Access Denied (0x80070005) after Claude Desktop update
signals.summary: Cowork workspace VM boots but fails at Plan9 share mount step (HCS 0x80070005 Access Denied) across Windows 10 and 11, breaking the core Cowork feature. All known Windows permission workarounds fail.
aliases: Plan9 share mount failed access denied
signals.review_reason: Cowork workspace is a primary differentiating feature of Claude Code for Windows users. The failure at the Plan9 share mount step (not at VM boot) means the VM infrastructure itself works, but the file sharing layer is completely broken post-update. Two independent Windows users (Win10 22H2 + Win11 25H2) cannot use Cowork, with all standard workarounds exhausted.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Plan9 share 'h' fails with HRESULT 0x80070005 (Access Denied) after Claude Desktop update — Windows 10 Pro 22H2
source_issues.evidence: Full regression: Cowork worked before update, now broken after. User exhausted ALL Windows troubleshooting steps including SYSTEM icacls on home directory, Bitdefender full disable, Hyper-V verification, reinstalls, MSIX path. Confirmed MSIX container may be the root cause blocking HCS Plan9 at kernel level.

source_issues.title: Cowork fails on Windows 11 Pro 25H2 — 'Virtual Machine Platform not available' despite VMP being enabled (yukonSilver not supported)
source_issues.evidence: Same Plan9/VM failure pattern on Windows 11 Pro 25H2. Labeled invalid but same root cause as #43290 — Cowork blocked on Windows broadly.

signals.topic: Token overconsumption — large file read repeatedly exceeds token limits, burning quota with no progress
signals.summary: Simple operations cause the model to repeatedly attempt reading files that exceed the 10,000-token file read limit, creating a retry loop that exhausts user quota without completing any task.
aliases: repeated file read errors burning quota
signals.review_reason: A clear token-wasting loop: the model attempts to read the same 14315-token file 6+ times in 8 hours without using offset/limit parameters, each attempt consuming tokens until the user hits a 429 rate limit. This is a quota-loss bug where simple operations cost multiples of their actual token value.

source_issues.title: You're out of extra usage · resets 8am (Asia/Tokyo)
source_issues.evidence: A single file (14315 tokens) repeatedly triggers MaxFileReadTokenExceededError across 6+ events over 8 hours. The model keeps attempting to read the same oversized file instead of using offset/limit, burning tokens on every retry. Results in 429 rate limit by end of day.

signals.topic: Microsoft 365 MCP OAuth authentication fails — duplicated 'prompt' query parameter rejected by Azure AD
signals.summary: Microsoft 365 MCP server generates OAuth URLs with a duplicated 'prompt' parameter, causing Azure AD to reject authentication. Users cannot use the Microsoft 365 MCP integration at all.
signals.review_reason: The Microsoft 365 MCP integration is completely broken: OAuth fails at first step due to a malformed URL. This blocks an entire enterprise integration (Microsoft 365/Outlook/Teams via MCP) with a clear, reproducible root cause (duplicate query parameter). Users cannot authenticate at all.

source_issues.title: Microsoft 365 MCP OAuth fails: duplicated 'prompt' parameter
source_issues.evidence: Clear root cause: the authorization URL contains 'prompt=select_account&...&prompt=consent', Azure AD rejects with AADSTS9000411. Workaround of manual URL editing then fails with AADSTS900971 (callback timeout). MCP integration is completely unusable.

signals.topic: SendMessage to running background agent silently drops queued messages when agent completes
signals.summary: When a message is sent to a running background agent via SendMessage, the system confirms it is queued, but the message is silently dropped when the agent finishes before the next delivery point. No error or notification.
signals.review_reason: Background agents are a core workflow feature. When SendMessage provides a success confirmation that the message was queued, but the message is then silently discarded on agent completion, users have false confidence their instructions were delivered. This breaks agent-based workflows where timely message injection is expected to work.

source_issues.title: [BUG] SendMessage to running agent: queued message silently dropped on completion
source_issues.evidence: SendMessage confirms 'Message queued for delivery' but message is silently discarded when the agent completes its task before the next tool round. No error, no notification. The user believes the message was sent but the agent never receives it.

signals.topic: Max Plan用户配额异常快速耗尽导致付费用户无法工作

aliases: Claude Code Max plan unusable due to quota

source_issues.title: [BUG] Max 20x plan ($200/mo) — quota exhausted in ~1h, making the product unusable for our team
source_issues.evidence: Max 20x ($200/mo) + 2x Max 5x ($100/mo) 订阅，共$400/月。自2026年3月23日起配额在60-90分钟内耗尽，产品不可用，团队无法工作，正评估竞品并考虑退订。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Max Plan User Getting 'Extra usage is required for long context requests' Error
source_issues.evidence: Max计划用户无法使用1M上下文（应默认包含），API返回429 rate limit错误提示'Extra usage is required'，请求验证billing/entitlement映射。用户付费购买的1M上下文功能不可用。

source_issues.title: You're out of extra usage · resets 8am (Asia/Tokyo)
source_issues.evidence: 轻量操作持续消耗配额至耗尽，导致多次429 rate limit错误和MaxFileReadTokenExceededError，extra usage提前耗尽迫使产品停止工作。

signals.topic: 后台Agent执行中SendMessage发送的消息在Agent完成后被静默丢弃
signals.summary: 向运行中的后台Agent发送SendMessage时，系统确认消息已入队（success=true），但当Agent在下一个工具轮次前完成任务时，该消息被静默丢弃，无任何错误提示或通知。用户认为消息已发送并等待响应，实际已被丢弃，导致Agent执行结果不完整，用户意图丢失。
aliases: SendMessage to running agent silently dropped
queued message lost on agent completion
signals.review_reason: 用户明确确认消息已入队但被静默丢弃——这是Agent工作流中的数据丢失，而非简单工具失败。对于依赖Agent间通信或任务中干预的用户，SendMessage是核心交互机制，其静默失败意味着用户指令丢失且无感知，属于主流程阻断。

source_issues.title: [BUG] SendMessage to running agent: queued message silently dropped on completion
source_issues.evidence: API明确返回{'success':true,'message':'Message queued for delivery'}，但Agent完成任务后消息从未被传递，无错误无通知。用户意图被静默丢弃，已提供可复现步骤。

signals.topic: Claude Code终端长行输出在边缘被截断不换行，导致部分输出永久不可见
signals.summary: macOS Terminal.app下，Claude Code输出中超过终端宽度的长行文本在右侧被截断，截断内容无法通过水平滚动查看，用户无法看到完整输出，需要要求Claude重新以短行输出，显著降低使用体验。
aliases: long lines cut off instead of wrapping
signals.review_reason: 长行截断导致Claude输出内容永久不可见，用户需要额外对话轮次来重新获取信息，体验下降明显。虽然是TUI层面问题而非主流程阻断，但影响日常使用频率高，属于体验显著下降类痛点。count=1故降为P2。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Long text output truncated/cut off at terminal edge on macOS
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告长行输出在终端宽度边界被截断，截断文本无法通过水平滚动访问，附有截图证据。用户需要求Claude重新以短行输出以获取完整信息。

signals.topic: gitStatus上下文首行空格被strip，导致staged与unstaged文件状态无法区分
signals.summary: Claude Code启动时会读取git status --short并注入gitStatus上下文，但首行的前导空格被trim掉。由于git status --short中staged用'M '（有空格）标识、unstaged用' M'（空格在M前）标识，首行空格丢失导致Claude无法区分staged和unstaged变更，可能产生错误的git操作指令。
aliases: staged vs unstaged distinction lost in gitStatus context
signals.review_reason: gitStatus是Claude Code的核心上下文机制，其错误数据会导致Claude执行错误的git操作（对unstaged文件执行commit/push），属于关键功能错误。虽然单issue count=1，但影响git工作流的正确性，降为P2。

source_issues.title: [BUG] gitStatus context trims leading whitespace from git status --short, hiding staged vs. unstaged distinction
source_issues.evidence: 提供实际git status --short输出与注入后的gitStatus对比：原输出' M file'被strip为首行'M file'，使staged和unstaged混淆。Claude基于错误信息可能产生错误的git commit/push指令。

signals.topic: Slash命令自动补全缺失部分plugin namespace的技能列表
signals.summary: 部分skill plugin namespace（如anthropic-skills:、data:、enterprise-search:）在输入/触发自动补全时不显示，但技能本身仍可被调用，仅是UI补全层缺失。用户必须记住完整技能名称才能使用，降低了技能发现性和使用效率。
aliases: skill plugin namespaces not appearing in autocomplete
signals.review_reason: 技能发现性严重下降，用户无法通过自动补全找到关键技能包（包含pdf/docx等常用工具），属于体验显著下降。技能实际可调用说明底层机制正常，但UX层bug影响高频使用场景，count=1故为P2。

source_issues.title: Slash command autocomplete missing skills from certain plugin namespaces
source_issues.evidence: 用户测试验证：输入/anthro、/feature-request-parser等prefix无结果，但engineering:等namespace正常显示。技能可调用但无法被发现，影响用户依赖的多个技能包（pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, data:*, enterprise-search:*等）。

signals.topic: Discord plugin DM reply fails with 'not allowlisted' when recipientId is undefined due to partial channel cache
signals.summary: fetchAllowedChannel() has mutually exclusive DM/guild paths. When DMChannel.recipientId is null/undefined (partial cache eviction), the DM allowlist check always fails, causing ~50% intermittent 'channel not allowlisted' errors on outbound DM replies even when the user is properly configured.
aliases: Discord DM channel allowlist intermittent failure
Discord DM reply blocked by partial cache
signals.review_reason: Key feature (Discord DM reply) intermittently fails (~50%) for properly configured users. The bot receives messages but cannot reply, leaving users with a broken conversational loop. This is a clear main-workflow blocking issue for Discord channel users.

source_issues.title: Discord plugin: intermittent 'channel is not allowlisted' on DM replies
source_issues.evidence: ~50% failure rate on outbound DM replies even with correct allowlist config; works right after inbound message, fails after cache eviction; root cause is null recipientId from partial DMChannel

source_issues.title: [BUG] fetchAllowedChannel() fails for DM channels when recipientId is undefined due to partial cache
source_issues.evidence: Mutual-exclusion logic in fetchAllowedChannel() causes DM path to fail when recipientId undefined; else branch never runs to check groups allowlist; intermittent reply failures even for properly allowlisted users

signals.topic: Ralph Loop stop hook fires in all sessions when CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is unset, blocking unrelated sessions
signals.summary: setup-ralph-loop.sh writes empty session_id when CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is not set. stop-hook.sh skips the session check when state_session is empty, causing the stop hook to match and block ALL sessions sharing the same .claude/ directory.
aliases: Ralph Loop stop hook blocks all sessions
ralph-loop session isolation broken in shared home environments
signals.review_reason: Main workflow (Claude Code session) is blocked across ALL sessions sharing the same .claude/ directory. This is a complete workflow failure for any user in a shared-home environment (Docker containers, web terminals like ttyd). Recovery requires manual file deletion.

source_issues.title: bug(ralph-loop): stop hook fires in all sessions when CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is unset
source_issues.evidence: Empty session_id in state file causes stop hook to match all sessions; all Claude Code sessions sharing ~/.claude/ get blocked; users must manually delete ralph-loop.local.md to recover; stop hook message repeats indefinitely across sessions

signals.topic: Hookify plugin throws JSON parse error on Windows due to backslash in file paths breaking escape sequences
signals.summary: Claude Code passes JSON to hook scripts via stdin. On Windows, file paths contain backslashes (e.g. C:\Users\stans\OneDrive). Sequences like \U, \s, \O are invalid JSON escapes, causing json.load() to fail. Error is displayed to user on every Stop event.
aliases: Hookify JSON parse error Windows backslash paths
Invalid backslash escape JSON error hookify on Windows
signals.review_reason: Hookify plugin is completely broken for all Windows users on every Stop event. The error message is displayed repeatedly to the user, making the plugin unusable. This is a complete feature blockage on the Windows platform.

source_issues.title: Hookify: Invalid \\escape JSON parse error on Windows (backslash in file paths)
source_issues.evidence: Error 'Invalid \\escape' shown to user on every Stop hook invocation on Windows; root cause is json.load(stdin) failing on Windows backslash paths; affects stop.py, pretooluse, posttooluse, and userpromptsubmit hooks

signals.topic: remember plugin save-session.sh uses dirname to derive PROJECT_DIR, breaking session saves when installed in plugin cache directory
signals.summary: save-session.sh derives PROJECT_DIR from dirname of script path instead of using CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR env var. When plugin is installed in ~/.claude/plugins/cache/, dirname resolution points to the cache directory where .claude/remember does not exist, causing all cd and session-save operations to silently fail.
aliases: remember plugin session save fails when installed as plugin
save-session.sh path resolution broken for marketplace plugin installations
signals.review_reason: remember plugin's core functionality (session memory capture and recovery) is completely broken for users who install it as a marketplace plugin. Session state is never saved and startup produces errors. This defeats the plugin's primary purpose of preserving session memory.

source_issues.title: remember: save-session.sh derives PROJECT_DIR from dirname instead of CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
source_issues.evidence: Background session saves silently fail every time when plugin is installed via marketplace; session recovery on startup fails causing SessionStart:clear hook error; now.md never written; errors: 'cd: No such file or directory' and ': integer expression expected'

signals.topic: Discord skill files hardcode ~/.claude/channels/discord/ path, ignoring DISCORD_STATE_DIR and breaking multi-bot setups
signals.summary: configure and access SKILL.md files hardcode ~/.claude/channels/discord/ for token and access.json paths, while server.ts correctly uses DISCORD_STATE_DIR. Claude reads the wrong files when DISCORD_STATE_DIR is set, making /discord:configure show 'Token: Not set' and /discord:access write to the wrong location.
aliases: Discord plugin DISCORD_STATE_DIR ignored by skills
Discord multi-instance setup broken by hardcoded paths in SKILL.md
signals.review_reason: Running multiple Discord bots from one machine with separate state directories is a core supported use case that is completely broken. The plugin connects to Discord correctly but skills report a broken state, creating a confusing UX where the plugin appears failed while actually working.

source_issues.title: Discord skills (/discord:configure, /discord:access) hardcode ~/.claude/channels/discord/ path — ignores DISCORD_STATE_DIR
source_issues.evidence: Multi-bot setups with separate DISCORD_STATE_DIR see 'Token: Not set' even though bots are connected; /discord:access pair writes to wrong file; plugin never sees pairing; user must manually write access.json to correct directory as workaround

signals.topic: iMessage outbound message echo causes self-response loop and burns tokens
signals.summary: When Claude sends outbound iMessages (e.g., via `gateway config.patch` notes), OC re-ingests its own outbound messages as inbound because the access-control logic allows `isSamePhone === true` messages without checking `isFromMe === true`. This triggers duplicate agent self-responses and burns significant Opus tokens.
signals.review_reason: Clear workflow-runtime pain point: the outbound echo loop causes duplicate agent self-responses, directly burning Opus tokens (~78k tokens, ~8% weekly quota in 30 min). Root cause is precisely identified in access-control-*.js (missing isFromMe check for isSamePhone==true). User had to fall back to webchat as workaround. Impact is financial (token cost) and operational (workflow disruption). Single issue but high confidence due to full reproduction + root cause + quantified impact.

source_issues.title: iMessage echo bug: isFromMe + isSamePhone messages not filtered
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction steps provided with root cause in access-control-*.js. Impact: ~8% weekly Opus quota burned in 30 minutes, 78k tokens on 3 API calls responding to own messages. isFromMe flag correctly set by imsg CLI but OC doesn't check it when isSamePhone is true.

signals.topic: Claude Code agent causes unexpected financial charges (~$45 USD)
signals.summary: Claude Code Opus 4.6 agent generated ~$45 USD in unexpected API costs for a Max subscriber, reported as a financial damage escalation request.
signals.review_reason: Significant financial impact (~$45 USD unexpected cost) confirmed by user. However, the issue is a cross-post from claude-code with no issue body detail beyond the cross-post link, so root cause and whether it was a runaway loop vs. legitimate use is unverified. Only 1 affected repo, count=1. Marked P2 due to single-occurrence and lack of detail, but financial damage is real user harm so keep=true.

source_issues.title: [SUPPORT] Financial damage report - Claude Code agent ~$45 USD
source_issues.evidence: User reports ~$45 USD financial damage caused by Claude Code Opus 4.6 agent. Cross-post from claude-code/issues/42329. Escalation to support/billing requested.

signals.topic: Claude Code agent 导致用户产生异常计费（财务损失）
signals.summary: Claude Code agent 在执行过程中产生超出用户预期的账单金额（如 $45 USD），导致财务损失。用户主动向 support/billing 发起投诉，跨仓 cross-post 至 claude-code 主仓库，表明该问题在多个渠道重复出现。
signals.review_reason: 用户产生真实财务损失且已投诉至 support/billing，跨仓 cross-post 表明主仓库 claude-code 存在对应 issue（#42329），属于计费异常场景。虽然该仓 count=1，但财务损失是明确的用户痛点证据，等级应为 P1 而非 P0。

source_issues.title: [SUPPORT] Financial damage report - Claude Code agent ~$45 USD
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确报告约 $45 USD 的财务损失，并要求升级至 support/billing 团队；cross-post 至 claude-code 主仓说明该问题非孤立个例。

signals.topic: MCP Playwright 课程实验步骤不完整，导致用户在配置阶段静默失败
signals.summary: Claude Code in Action 课程中 MCP Playwright 配置说明仅提供 `claude mcp add` 命令，但缺少安装浏览器依赖、OS 级依赖及重启 Claude Code 等关键步骤，导致学生在实际操作中 MCP 工具静默不可用，无法完成课程实验。此外 Ubuntu 25.x 系统上 `install-deps` 本身因包名过时而失败，形成双重阻断。
signals.review_reason: 缺失的实验步骤直接导致学生无法完成课程核心实验（静默失败），属于体验显著下降+主流程部分阻断。issue 提供了详细的复现路径和环境信息（Ubuntu 25.x 包名兼容性问题），有评论互动，属于有用户影响证据的真实痛点。count=1 且仅单仓，默认不升 P0。

source_issues.title: Claude Code in Action: MCP Playwright setup instructions missing critical steps
source_issues.evidence: issue 详细列出 3 个缺失步骤（npx playwright install、sudo npx playwright install-deps、重启 Claude Code），并指出 Ubuntu 25.x 上 install-deps 本身失败的问题；学生遇到 MCP 工具静默不可用，无法完成课程实验，主流程被阻断。

signals.topic: Example skills license too restrictive, blocking legitimate reuse and learning
signals.summary: The example skills (e.g., xlsx) carry a restrictive license that prohibits extraction, reproduction, and derivative works, making it difficult for users to reuse or learn from example code.
signals.review_reason: Single-issue but represents a real workflow blocker: users cannot legally extract, reproduce, or create derivative works from example skills, directly impacting the primary use case of a skills repository (learning by example). The complaint surfaces a licensing mismatch between the 'example skills' purpose and the restrictive license, which would suppress community contribution and skill adoption. Not P0 only because count=1 with no cross-repo evidence.

source_issues.title: Why does example skills have so restrictive license?
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states the license prohibits extract, reproduce, copy, and create derivative works, which blocks legitimate learning and reuse workflows.

signals.topic: MOIM injection and Summon extension produce excessive warning-level log spam
signals.summary: The MOIM (Top Of Mind) extension emits 100+ WARN-level log messages per session due to automatic message correction. The Summon extension emits frontmatter parsing warnings at every startup and subagent delegation. This log pollution makes it difficult to identify real errors.
signals.review_reason: While not a crash, the WARN-level log spam (100+ messages per session from MOIM, repeated per-delegation from Summon) significantly degrades the debugging experience and obscures real errors. Users must wade through noise to find actual problems. This is a persistent quality-of-use regression.

source_issues.title: bug: MOIM injection produces hundreds of warnings per session (log spam)
source_issues.evidence: 142 occurrences of 'MOIM injection caused unexpected issues' warnings logged in a single session. Auto-corrected issues are logged at WARN level instead of DEBUG, producing massive log pollution.

source_issues.title: bug: Summon extension emits 'missing field name' frontmatter warnings on every startup
source_issues.evidence: Exactly 2 'Failed to parse frontmatter: missing field name' warnings at startup, repeating on every subagent delegation. 18+ occurrences in a single long session. Warning does not identify which files are failing.

signals.topic: Code Mode crashes on macOS 26 (V8 OOM / heap initialization failure)
signals.summary: Code Mode extension causes goosed to crash 100% of the time on macOS 26 (Tahoe) during V8 heap initialization. Users see a SIGTRAP/EXC_BREAKPOINT crash preventing any use of Code Mode.
signals.review_reason: Full desktop app crash with 100% reproducibility; user sees SIGTRAP/EXC_BREAKPOINT and an error screen. Code Mode is entirely unusable on affected macOS 26 systems. This is a primary workflow blocker (P0).

source_issues.title: Code Mode crashes with V8 OOM on macOS 26 (Tahoe) — Heap::SetUp fails on isolate init
source_issues.evidence: 100% reproducible crash; SIGTRAP/EXC_BREAKPOINT during V8 heap setup on macOS 26.3.1 M1 Max; crash prevents any Code Mode usage; workaround is to disable Code Mode entirely.

signals.topic: Toolshim streaming JSON truncation causes MCP tool call failures for non-Anthropic models
signals.summary: Tool calls fail with JSON parse errors (EOF, unexpected end of string) when streaming large or small payloads to custom OpenAI-compatible providers. Root cause: the JSON parser doesn't handle truncated JSON from streaming SSE chunks.
signals.review_reason: Direct user-facing failure of core tool execution. JSON parse errors cause write and shell tools to fail mid-session, preventing the main agent workflow from completing. Multiple related issues (#8167, #2892) show this is a known recurring problem not yet resolved.

source_issues.title: bug: Tool call JSON parse failures with large payloads and streaming fragments
source_issues.evidence: Shell tool calls fail with 'EOF while parsing a string'; write tool calls fail with 'expected , or } at column 27409/58872'. Affects non-Anthropic models via OpenAI-compatible proxy. Related issues #8167 and #2892 were closed without definitive fix.

signals.topic: Toolshim OllamaInterpreter fails to recognize streaming tool call fragments (returns noop)
signals.summary: When toolshim is enabled, each SSE streaming chunk is sent individually to the OllamaInterpreter. Small local models (e.g., qwen3:1.7b) return 'noop' for every fragment because they cannot identify partial JSON tool call boundaries.
aliases: small model tool call recognition failure
signals.review_reason: Core tool execution failure for toolshim users with small local models. All tool calls are silently converted to noop, making the toolshim entirely non-functional. Users with streaming non-Anthropic models cannot execute any tools.

source_issues.title: bug: Toolshim OllamaInterpreter returns noop for all streaming tool call fragments
source_issues.evidence: Each SSE chunk sent in isolation to OllamaInterpreter returns 'noop'. Small models (qwen3:1.7b) cannot recognize partial tool call fragments. Toolshim is non-functional for streaming tool calls with small local models.

signals.topic: Developer extension hardcodes Ollama dependency — blocks usage without Ollama installed
signals.summary: The developer built-in extension unconditionally connects to Ollama at localhost:11434 for message augmentation. Users with cloud-only setups or custom OpenAI-compatible providers cannot use the developer extension at all.
signals.review_reason: The developer extension (which provides core file read/write and command execution tools) is completely unusable for any user without Ollama installed. This blocks the entire extension ecosystem for cloud-only setups, representing a major functional failure.

source_issues.title: feat: allow configuring provider for developer extension's message augmentation (hardcoded Ollama dependency)
source_issues.evidence: Enabling developer extension with OpenAI-compatible provider (NadirClaw) fails: 'Could not connect to localhost:11434'. No environment variable or config can redirect augmentation to a non-Ollama endpoint. Blocks all users without Ollama from using the developer extension.

signals.topic: StagehandLogger缺少warning方法导致init()在特定环境下崩溃
signals.summary: Python SDK的StagehandLogger对象缺少warning属性/方法，当在只读文件系统上初始化时触发AttributeError，导致stagehand.init()崩溃，用户主流程阻断。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断型bug：stagehand.init()在常见部署环境（只读文件系统）下抛出未捕获的AttributeError导致程序崩溃，不是边缘场景而是真实阻断。Python SDK的日志方法实现不完整，缺少warning方法在异常处理路径中被调用，造成init()无法完成。用户受影响路径明确：只读分区+downloads_path配置→触发OSError→异常处理中调用warning→AttributeError→init崩溃。

source_issues.title: Logger error: 'StagehandLogger' object has no attribute 'warning'
source_issues.evidence: 当downloads_path挂载在只读分区时，stagehand.init()触发OSError后，在异常处理中调用self.logger.warning()导致AttributeError: 'StagehandLogger' object has no attribute 'warning'，主流程init()崩溃退出。

signals.topic: Docker 部署后容器无限重启循环
signals.summary: 拉取最新代码后执行 docker compose up，容器陷入启动失败→重启死循环，主流程完全阻断。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：docker compose up 成功后应用立即进入无限重启循环，用户完全无法使用。日志有明确错误信息（RuntimeError: gateway startup failed），截图提供视觉证据，1条强证据。

source_issues.title: docker 部署 最新几条 pull 代码会导致无限重启
source_issues.evidence: docker compose up 后容器进入无限重启循环，日志显示 RuntimeError: Failed to load configuration during gateway startup，截图显示持续重启状态，影响用户无法正常使用 DeerFlow。

signals.topic: 工具调用函数名重复导致所有工具 100% 调用失败
signals.summary: AI 调用任何工具时函数名被系统重复（如 ls→lsls），导致全部工具调用失败，用户完全失去工具能力。
aliases: 工具名重复导致调用失败
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断且高频影响：所有工具调用100%失败，AI完全丧失文件操作、搜索等核心能力。影响范围覆盖ls、read_file、write_file等所有工具，系统性缺陷，1条高质量证据（明确错误日志+复现步骤+影响工具清单）。

source_issues.title: TOOL INVOCATION BUG REPORT: SYSTEMATIC FUNCTION NAME DUPLICATION
source_issues.evidence: ls→lsls, read_file→read_fileread_file, write_file→write_filewrite_file，100%失败率；错误信息：'lsls is not a valid tool'；AI完全无法执行文件操作、网页搜索等所有工具任务；loop detection触发后重试也失败；跨会话持续存在。

signals.topic: /api/agents 接口不返回 soul 字段，Agent 自定义内容丢失
signals.summary: 通过 /api/agents GET 查询自定义 Agent 时，soul 字段始终为空，必须逐个调用 /api/agents/{name} 才能获取完整内容，API 数据不完整。
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：Agent 自定义内容（soul字段）是核心配置数据，列表接口缺失此字段导致用户无法批量获取完整的 Agent 信息，需要逐个查询，显著增加调用成本并影响用户体验。

source_issues.title: [runtime] list custom agents 接口无法返回soul字段
source_issues.evidence: 创建 agent 后通过 /api/agents PUT 修改 soul，通过 /api/agents 查询返回的 soul 为空；直接调用 /api/agents/{name} GET 才能看到完整内容；用户无法批量获取所有 agent 的完整信息。

signals.topic: Bash 工具处理路径时尾部斜杠丢失导致路径拼接错误
signals.summary: bash 工具解析命令行中以斜杠结尾的路径时，斜杠在虚拟路径映射过程中被吞掉，导致路径拼接结果错误（如 /workspace/ + file.txt → /workspacesome_file.txt）。
aliases: bash tool path trailing slash lost
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：路径拼接是文件操作高频场景，尾部斜杠丢失导致生成的路径完全错误，AI 的文件写入/读取等操作会写入错误路径或失败，影响 LocalSandbox 模式下的所有文件操作。

source_issues.title: bash工具会吞掉命令行中路径的末尾斜杠
source_issues.evidence: 要求运行 'python -c "output_dir = '/mnt/data-user/workspace/'; print(output_dir + 'some_file.txt')"'，预期 '/mnt/data-user/workspace/some_file.txt'，实际 '/mnt/data-user/workspacesome_file.txt'（尾部斜杠被吞掉导致路径粘连）；影响所有包含尾部斜杠的路径操作。

signals.topic: DeerFlowClient.stream() 不暴露 SubAgent 执行事件，可观测性缺失
signals.summary: SubAgent 内部的 task_started/task_running/task_completed 等执行事件被静默丢弃，调用方无法追踪子任务的执行进度、中间步骤和失败原因。
aliases: client stream 缺少执行事件
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：SubAgent 执行是 DeerFlow 核心能力，但 orchestrator（编排层）完全看不到子任务的执行细节，导致长时间运行的 SubAgent 对调用方表现为黑盒，严重影响生产环境可观测性和调试能力。

source_issues.title: DeerFlowClient.stream() does not expose SubAgent execution events
source_issues.evidence: task_tool.py 内部已通过 get_stream_writer() 发送 task_started/task_running/task_completed 等事件，但 client.py 中 stream_mode 仅监听 'values'，自定义事件被静默丢弃；调用方无法追踪 SubAgent 执行进度，调试时无法了解内部状态。

signals.topic: Cline Kanban mode task execution and state management failures
signals.summary: Cline Kanban mode fails to create tasks on the board, fails to execute run_commands, and loses all session state after process crash with no reliable recovery.
signals.review_reason: Three independent reports (count=3) covering different aspects of kanban mode failures: task execution fails (#10123), board state not updated (#10053), and session state lost after crash (#10052). Together these represent a complete breakdown of the kanban workflow — the primary new feature of Cline CLI. Count=3 meets P0 threshold with clear blocking evidence: tasks cannot execute, board is not populated, and crash recovery causes data loss.

source_issues.title: Cline kanban run_commands one or more tool calls were invalid or missing required parameters
source_issues.evidence: Opening cline kanban mode and creating a new task always fails with error: 'One or more tool calls were invalid or missing required parameters (run_commands)'. Tasks fail to execute. Cline TUI works fine in comparison.

source_issues.title: Cline Kanban not using kanban board, no tasks created and no orchestration on board, but execution in chat window
source_issues.evidence: AI model successfully executes tasks in chat window but does not create any tasks on the kanban board. The board remains empty despite active task execution. Core kanban orchestration feature is broken.

source_issues.title: cline kanban: not restoring sessions after process crash
source_issues.evidence: WSL crashed (likely OOM), after restarting cline kanban, all cards are in the trash. Restore is very slow and some never restore. Cards show 'in progress' but nothing progresses. Significant data loss after crash with no reliable recovery mechanism.

signals.topic: Terminal integration hangs on bash errors and heredoc commands, with Cancel causing UI deadlock
signals.summary: Shell commands with syntax errors or heredoc syntax cause the terminal to hang indefinitely. Additionally, pressing Cancel while stuck leaves the UI in a deadlocked state.
signals.review_reason: Three reports (count=3) all showing terminal integration failures when handling shell output: heredoc commands fail to capture output (#10066), HTML-escaped operators cause bash errors (#10064), and bash syntax errors leave terminal hanging (#10063). Additionally, issue #10066 shows Cancel button deadlocks the UI. These are workflow-blocking failures where users cannot recover without workarounds. Count=3 and P0 threshold met with explicit evidence of main workflow disruption and UI deadlock.

source_issues.title: Heredoc execution breaks terminal output handling (result missing/hang), and Cancel may freeze chat UI
source_issues.evidence: Inline heredoc commands via Cline do not complete normally — output capture fails, step ends with 'result missing' or hangs in pending state. Verified same heredoc works in regular terminal. In 3.76.0, pressing Cancel on stuck step turns Cancel grey, Resume unavailable, cannot send new message — UI deadlock.

source_issues.title: execute_command renders && literally in bash command, causing syntax error and stuck process
source_issues.evidence: execute_command emits '&&' as HTML entity '&&' causing bash syntax error. Process gets stuck afterwards and does not recover normally.

source_issues.title: Terminal stalls after bash syntax error when command contains escaped quotes/parentheses
source_issues.evidence: Shell command triggering bash parse error causes terminal/process to hang instead of returning non-zero exit + error output. Tool execution does not complete normally. User cannot proceed with subsequent tool runs.

signals.topic: Terminal output capture causes extension freeze/crash and UI unresponsiveness
signals.summary: Cline's terminal output capture repeatedly fails and enters infinite retry loops, causing the extension host to crash, memory exhaustion, and complete UI unresponsiveness. Users must restart VS Code repeatedly.
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports (count=2) show terminal output capture failure causing extension host crash loop and UI freeze. Issue #10108 shows memory exhaustion, 115+ errors per session, extension becomes unusable in 2-5 minutes. Issue #10122 shows UI completely unresponsive after execute_command, recoverable only via VS Code restart. This is a clear P0: main workflow is blocked, extension becomes completely unusable, and users must repeatedly restart. High confidence from multiple independent reports with detailed logs.

source_issues.title: Extension host crash loop: terminal output capture failure + PendingMigrationError causing memory exhaustion
source_issues.evidence: Error 'Error while asking for command output' occurs 115+ times per session. Terminal buffers not released, memory accumulates. PendingMigrationError for navigator global in Node.js v22. ENOENT in focus_chain file loading. Extension becomes unusable after 2-5 minutes. Users must restart VS Code repeatedly.

source_issues.title: Cline freezes indefinitely in 'thinking' state after execute_command reads terminal output, making UI unresponsive
source_issues.evidence: After execute_command reads terminal output, Cline enters 'thinking' state and freezes indefinitely. UI completely unresponsive: user cannot abort task, send new message, or start new task. Happened at least 4 times. Only recovery is restarting VS Code.

signals.topic: Cline extension causes high CPU load and prevents macOS from sleeping
signals.summary: The VS Code extension with Cline active causes persistently high CPU usage and prevents macOS from entering sleep mode, indicating a background polling or activity loop that wastes system resources.
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports (count=2) showing resource leak symptoms: high CPU load (#10118, confirmed via CPU profiling) and macOS sleep prevention (#10054, confirmed via extension bisect). While not directly blocking workflow, these indicate persistent background activity loops consuming CPU and battery. The sleep prevention is a system-level impact — Cline keeps the machine awake even when idle. Combined evidence is strong and consistent.

source_issues.title: Extension causes high cpu load
source_issues.evidence: Extension causes high CPU load confirmed via VS Code extension bisect and CPU profiling. User attached cpuprofile.txt from home directory confirming the issue source.

source_issues.title: Cline preventing sleep on macos
source_issues.evidence: VS Code with Cline extension prevents macOS from sleeping regardless of whether Cline chat window is open. Extension bisect confirms saoudrizwan.claude-dev (Cline) is the problem extension. Disabling Cline resolves the sleep prevention issue.

signals.topic: AGENTS.md file not auto-loaded from global Rules directory with misleading 'already exists' error
signals.summary: Placing AGENTS.md in the global Rules directory (~/.config/Cline/Rules/) causes Cline to not load it on startup, and the Rules UI shows a misleading 'already exists' error when trying to add it manually.
signals.review_reason: Single report (count=1) showing rules loading failure for AGENTS.md specifically. The file is detected ('already exists' error) but not loaded, breaking user workflow for configuring custom rules. The misleading error message compounds the issue. Downgraded to P2 due to count=1 and single-repository impact. However, it qualifies as a pain point because it blocks a documented configuration workflow.

source_issues.title: AGENTS.md not loaded automatically from global Rules directory
source_issues.evidence: AGENTS.md placed in ~/Documents/Cline/Rules/ is not loaded on startup. Attempting to add via Rules UI shows error 'rule file AGENTS.md already exists', indicating Cline detects the file but fails to load its contents. This breaks user-configured rules workflow.

signals.topic: OpenAI Responses API (o1/o3-mini) 推理模型工具调用返回 400/500 错误
signals.summary: OpenAI Responses API 与推理模型组合使用时，工具调用流程因 item 顺序和 sanitization 逻辑问题触发 API 验证错误。用户无法在推理模型中正常使用工具（文件读写等），属于核心功能退化。
aliases: OpenAI Responses API 400 reasoning tool call
o1 o3 tool call validation error
OpenAI Responses API item ordering bug
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断+高频（3个相关issue，根因均为 OpenAI Responses API 与推理模型的交互缺陷）。工具调用是 Continue 的核心能力，推理模型用户完全无法使用工具，属于关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug] OpenAI Responses API 400 Bad Request: 'Missing reasoning item' with Reasoning Models
source_issues.evidence: OpenAI Responses API enforces strict reasoning/message item ordering. toResponsesInput emits function_call before message, violating API sequence requirements. Causes 400 'Missing reasoning item' error.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Tool call duplication in UI when streaming with OpenAI Responses API
source_issues.evidence: OpenAI Responses API tool call deltas lack index property. UI treats each chunk as new execution, causing rapid visual duplication of tool calls in chat view.

source_issues.title: [Bug] 500 Internal Server Error in OpenAI o1/o3-mini Reasoning API when using tools
source_issues.evidence: sanitizeResponsesInput strips function_call IDs incorrectly when encrypted_content is missing, leaving orphan tool outputs. API receives malformed sequence and returns 500 Internal Server Error.

signals.topic: OpenAI organization verification error blocking o3/o1 reasoning model usage
signals.summary: Users invoking reasoning models (o3, o1-preview, o3-mini) via OpenAI API receive 'Your organization must be verified' 400 errors, making reasoning models completely unusable even for verified organizations.
aliases: OpenAI reasoning model blocked by verification requirement
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断，高频出现（2个独立用户报告）。推理模型（o3/o1）是 Continue 的核心能力，用户完全无法使用。错误信息指向 API 配置问题而非用户端问题，属于平台侧配置缺陷。

source_issues.title: Error: o3 - 400
source_issues.evidence: o3 model returns 400 with 'Your organization must be verified' error, blocking reasoning model usage.
